kyoto_osteria_bastille.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, bread and breaded dishes sit beside steak, game, carpaccio and salads; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_osteria_bastille.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the official site stresses organic vegetables from Kyoto and Shiga growers, but most dishes are meat or fish (Tabelog; official site; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_osteria_bastille.hours_raw: Thu and Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00); Fri, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Mon–Wed for dining, with catering and large take-away orders (Tabelog; official site, January 2025). Bookings advised — "Reservations are necessary" (October 2025 review); lunch courses can be booked, other lunches by phone from 10:00 (February 2026 review). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし"; a ¥440 seat-and-bread charge applies to table-only bookings (Tabelog). Lunch is cash only; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay at dinner (Tabelog). 22 seats, about five tables (March 2022 review); children welcome; non-smoking (Tabelog). 5 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_osteria_bastille.notes: [Italian-French bistro · near Shijo-Karasuma] A cosy, antique-filled osteria of about 22 years, mixing Italian and French: carpaccio, sakura-shrimp pasta, game such as venison braised in red wine, and generous lunch sets around ¥1,800–2,900. Lunch Thu–Sun, dinner Fri–Sat only; book ahead, and bring cash for lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the chef draws on training abroad to take "the best of French and Italian"; the name comes from the Bastille quarter of Paris; the 22nd anniversary was marked in December 2025; in recent years the shop has added catering, markets and outdoor events. A long-time regular describes it as "run by a lovely couple" (August 2025 review), while the official site advertises for part-time staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: A "上質な日常" (a fine everyday) in a European room of antique furniture; safe food with clear origins, buying organic vegetables directly from Kyoto and Shiga growers (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Italian-French bistro dishes; game in season.

anecdotes.text: A diner of nearly 20 years called it a warm restaurant whose gentle flavours reflect the owners' kind personalities — August 2025.
In October 2025 a couple had the season's first venison, from Shiga, and found it remarkably tender.
Calling on a snowy February 2026 morning, two friends got a same-day table and said the meal "blew our taste buds away".
A September 2026 pair noted the pasta came split onto two plates unasked.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: オステリア バスティーユ、中京区烏丸蛸薬師東入ル一蓮社町310 メゾン高見1F、シェフ 山本 知 (SATORU YAMAMOTO)、海外での修行を生かしたフレンチとイタリアンのいいとこ取り、京都・滋賀の生産者から仕入れる有機野菜、アンティーク家具の空間、ケータリング・ランチボックス・ネットショップ、月火水休み (ケータリング対応)・木日ランチのみ・金土ランチとディナー (2025年1月)、2025年12月に22周年、アルバイト募集中。食べログ (店舗会員): イタリアン・フレンチ・ダイニングバー、22席、サービス料なし、席のみ予約は席料・パン代440円、ランチは現金のみ。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年9月、英語): 夫婦で営む温かい店、前菜盛り合わせ、カルパッチョ、桜海老のパスタ、砂肝とベーコンのサラダ、鹿肉、日替わり1,800円、パスタセット2,900円、予約推奨。

cultural_comfort.note: Small bistro; book ahead; cash only at lunch.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop and the official site (news dated April 2026); reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_griddle_force_itsuraku.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan steak with sauces, a curry to finish, croquettes and fried sets at lunch; no gluten information (Tabelog; official site; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_griddle_force_itsuraku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a teppanyaki steak restaurant (Tabelog).
kyoto_griddle_force_itsuraku.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30; lunch ends when sold out) and 18:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). The official site gives dinner as 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「席のみ予約のお客様には、お通し代として、500円頂いております。」 — a ¥500 appetizer charge for seat-only bookings. Lunch is cash only (August 2025 and October 2026 reviews); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY per Tabelog. 16 seats: 10 at the counter and a hidden private room for six reached by a side passage and an intercom at the back door (Tabelog; official site gives 12 + 6). Children at lunch; at dinner only in the private room (Tabelog). Free Wi-Fi; non-smoking. 5 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_griddle_force_itsuraku.notes: [Teppanyaki steak · near Shijo-Karasuma] A ten-seat teppan counter with a secret private room behind, where the chef grills Kyoto beef in front of you and finishes with a small curry instead of garlic rice. The lunch steak set (about ¥1,400, cash only) is the draw; dinner courses with lobster and wagyu run ¥8,000–10,000. Closed Monday.

roles: Manager (店長), maker of the finishing curry
chef_bio.background: Opened 19 November 2015 (Tabelog). The official site also links a sister izakaya, 居酒屋いつらく (kushiyaki).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto beef fillet and sirloin, the day's best from a trusted Kyoto supplier, paired with wine (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan steak; 吉田's mini curry to finish.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 lunch guest watched the chef grill lean beef on the teppan and cut it into bite-size pieces, at about ¥1,200.
A May 2026 diner loved the course and the private room but wished the staff were friendlier and the coffee deeper.
An October 2026 lunch guest was told to move to the end seat after choosing a seat, and that cards were not taken at lunch.
In October 2026 a guest left food and drinks to the chef and staff for a reunion dinner ending in the house curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: GRIDDLE FORCE.逸楽、中京区一連社町298-2 染匠会館1F、京都牛のフィレとサーロイン、店長の吉田が作る〆のミニカレー、グラスワイン赤白各3種・ボトル20種以上、店内奥の完全個室 (6名、裏口のインターフォンから)、ランチ 11:30〜14:00、ディナー 17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、月曜休み、18席、姉妹店の居酒屋いつらく。食べログ (店舗会員): 鉄板焼き・ステーキ、2015年11月19日オープン、火〜日 11:30〜14:00・18:00〜22:00、16席、席のみ予約はお通し代500円、金目鯛のカルパッチョ、仔羊フィレ。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): ステーキランチ大中小、中225g 1,400円、ランチは現金のみ、ロブスターと和牛のコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seating; cash only at lunch.

kyoto_goko_machi_sasaki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura izakaya; the batter is wheat. Sashimi and simmered dishes exist, but fryer and broth are shared (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_goko_machi_sasaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and meat dishes; vegetable tempura is served with dashi-based broth (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goko_machi_sasaki.hours_raw: 15:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken online; parties of five or more by phone. "If you are unable to order from the Japanese menu, we will accommodate you with a course menu" (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 at tables; children and strollers welcome; non-smoking, smoking area outside; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Goko Machi Street, in the former home of Umaimonya Issho (February 2026 review); 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_goko_machi_sasaki.notes: [Tempura izakaya · Goko Machi Street near Kyoto City Hall] A calm counter-and-table izakaya, opened 2024, frying Edo-style tempura in sesame oil to order — clams in the shell with broth, Kamo eggplant, lotus root — alongside sashimi, duck roast and good sake. Opens at 15:00 for an early drink; about ¥6,000–8,000. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 June 2024 (Tabelog), in the former home of Umaimonya Issho (February 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Edo-style tempura in sesame oil that brings out the ingredients, with seasonal dishes from the morning market (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sesame-oil Edo-style tempura.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner found some drinks and dishes unavailable and the busy owner a bit unfriendly.
An August 2026 guest arriving at 16:30 was first in, followed by two older local couples; the ayu simmered with sansho sold out as the couples ordered it.
In October 2026 the master cooked alone; a pair ordered the clam tempura twice, and a staff member who came in later served a foreign family in fluent English.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 御幸町ささき、居酒屋・天ぷら、中京区御幸町通押小路上る山本町427、京都市役所前駅から徒歩7分、15:00〜22:00、水曜休み、2024年6月27日オープン、16席 (カウンター8・テーブル8)、子供可、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、カード可、関西では珍しい胡麻油の江戸前天ぷら、市場の旬の一品、刺身、おばんざい、日本酒15〜20種、日本語の品書きで注文できない方にはコースで対応。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): 牡蠣の Tamayose 770円、鴨ロース1,100円、ぶりのレアカツ1,540円、蛤の天ぷら、なす、唐辛子、海老とセロリの春巻き、焼売、店主が一人で揚げる、英語の堪能なスタッフ、店主が忙しく無愛想という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese menu; a course is offered to guests who cannot order from it (Tabelog); an English-speaking staff member was seen in October 2026.

kyoto_sake_dokoro_shikata.gf_detail: Ask. Dote-ni and oden in soy-based broth, sashimi, clay-pot rice; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_dokoro_shikata.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-tendon dote-ni, fish and dashi dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_dokoro_shikata.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily; hours may change, check before visiting (Tabelog). Hitosara gives 17:00–24:00 with irregular holidays. Bookings taken (Tabelog). Counter on the ground floor, tables upstairs with a dumbwaiter by the stairs (August and November 2026 reviews); children welcome; non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). In a traditional Kyoto machiya (October 2026 review); about 300 m from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; October 2026 review).
kyoto_sake_dokoro_shikata.notes: [Machiya izakaya · near Karasuma Oike] A stylish townhouse izakaya, counter downstairs and tables up: the signature dote-ni, oden, seasonal small plates and a clay-pot rice whose leftovers come back as onigiri to take away. About ¥3,000–5,000 with drinks; portions suit two, and staff offer solo-size helpings. Daily from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff in a traditional Kyoto machiya, popular with a younger crowd (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Dote-ni; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 first-timer was told up front that portions serve about two, which helped with ordering.
An October 2026 diner was disappointed by the lack of Japanese sake on the menu, while an October 2026 traveller praised the drinks list.
A November 2026 party found the ikura dishes sold out and the dumbwaiter beside the upstairs table noisy, but loved the dote and oden.
A salt-averse October 2026 diner found the oden and doteyaki strong in soy but delicious.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒処 四方、居酒屋、中京区烏帽子屋町477、烏丸御池駅から302m、毎日17:00〜23:00 (変更あり)、予約可、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可。ヒトサラ: 17:00〜24:00、不定休。口コミ (2026年6〜11月、英語): 町家の居酒屋、1階カウンターと2階テーブル、名物の土手煮 (土手煮丼)、おでん、もつ煮、ねぎとろ、ポテサラとしめ鯖、鶏ももたたき、無花果の白ごまの和え物、土鍋ご飯の残りはおにぎりにして持ち帰り可、2人前ほどの量でおひとり様向けの量にも、日本酒がないという声と飲み物の品揃えを褒める声、2階の運搬機の音。四方食店 (姥柳町) との関係を示す資料は見つからなかった。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff offer solo-size portions; book ahead at weekends.

kyoto_entokuin_amex_lounge.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese sweets served with the tea (2025–26 reviews); no ingredient information. The teas named in reviews are kombu tea, Uji tea and barley tea.
kyoto_entokuin_amex_lounge.vegan_detail: Ask. Tea (kombu tea, Uji tea, barley tea, ume kombucha, hiyashi ame) and a Japanese sweet (2023–26 reviews); no ingredient information for the sweets.
kyoto_entokuin_amex_lounge.hours_raw: AMEX CARDHOLDERS ONLY: entry is for holders of an AMEX Gold or Business Gold card or higher (Tabelog remarks; reviews from August 2024, December 2025 and May 2026), and the cardholder’s companions may come in too (April 2026). A cardholder with a US-issued AMEX was turned away and entered on a friend’s card (April 2026), so the card may need to be issued in Japan. 10:00–17:00 daily, closed irregularly (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Tea, sweets and entry to Entoku-in (normally ¥500) are free for cardholders (December 2025); nothing to pay. 20 tatami seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Kodai-ji parking free for 1 hour (Tabelog). Enter by a back gate off Nene no Michi with an AMEX sign, not the temple’s main entrance (February and August 2024); ring the bell if no one is there; shoes off (April 2026).
kyoto_entokuin_amex_lounge.notes: [AMEX lounge · Kodai-ji, tea in a temple — AMEX Gold cardholders or higher only] A tea room inside Entoku-in, the Kodai-ji sub-temple, open only to holders of an AMEX Gold card or higher and anyone accompanying a cardholder (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews); one April 2026 visitor with a US-issued card was refused. Through a back gate off Nene no Michi, ring the bell, leave shoes, and sit on tatami over the garden with free seasonal tea — kombu tea, Uji tea, chilled hiyashi ame — and a sweet. Entry to the temple, sutra copying and a miniature dry-garden are included. 10:00–17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: the AMEX cardholder lounge in Entoku-in, a sub-temple of Kodai-ji, described in May 2023 as the only AMEX lounge outside an airport and in December 2025 as the Entoku-in Guest Hall, formerly the Kyoto Special Tourist Lounge. Tabelog links the AMEX Japan benefits page and states that only Amex Gold or Amex Business Gold cardholders or higher may enter.
chef_bio.specialty: Complimentary seasonal tea and a sweet.

anecdotes.text: A May 2023 visitor was welcomed after ringing the bell in the courtyard and served ume kombucha at a high tea table; Uji tea, ume water, kombu tea and roasted tea rotate.
A February 2024 visitor likened the place to a relative’s grandmother’s house crossed with a ninja mansion, with a hanging scroll within reach.
A June 2026 regular singled out the hiyashi ame, a chilled ginger drink, for humid days.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 東山区高台寺下河原町530、祇園四条から761m、10:00〜17:00、不定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席、座敷、禁煙、高台寺駐車場1時間無料、備考 (英訳): Amex Gold と Amex Business Gold 以上のカード会員のみ入場可。口コミ (2022年7月〜2026年6月、英語): AMEX Gold 以上で無料、同伴者も可、米国発行のカードでは入れなかった (2026年4月)、昆布茶・梅昆布茶・Uji のお茶・麦茶・冷やし飴と和菓子、圓徳院の拝観 (通常500円) も無料、写経、小さな枯山水づくり、Nene no Michi 側の裏口、呼び鈴、靴を脱ぐ。

cultural_comfort.note: Entry only with an AMEX Gold card or higher (companions welcome); a US-issued card was refused in April 2026, so check the card qualifies. Find the back gate off Nene no Michi, ring the bell, shoes off; staff serve the tea.

kyoto_ippin_hashinaga.gf_detail: Ask. Set courses that include tempura and fried dishes (March 2025, June 2026) and soy-seasoned dishes; no gluten information.
kyoto_ippin_hashinaga.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led courses built on dashi — clear soups, dobin-mushi, chawanmushi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_ippin_hashinaga.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry 19:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the shop asks for a call before visiting as it is small (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR, but lunch and all-you-can-drink cannot be paid by card (Tabelog). 20 seats: 6 at the counter and 12 on tatami; semi-private rooms separated by blinds, private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Muromachi north of Takoyakushi; 5 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 21 April 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ippin_hashinaga.notes: [Kappo · Shijo Muromachi, monthly courses at a fair price] A small counter-and-tatami kappo on Muromachi that has served monthly-changing courses since 2011: a ¥3,500–4,400 lunch of chirashi sushi, sashimi, tempura and homemade chirimen sansho rice, and dinner courses from about ¥6,000, with hamo in summer and matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn. Desserts are homemade; Kyoto sake. Lunch is cash or e-money only. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), described as kind and explaining each dish (October 2025)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant particular about fish and sake, opened 21 April 2011, with 6 counter seats and 12 on tatami. An April 2025 diner learned the menu changes monthly.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo courses; hamo in summer, matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner found the dashi in the soup course so good it could be sipped forever, and was so taken with the meal that work talk never came up.
An August 2026 diner chose between hamo courses: about one piece a dish at ¥6,000, about five at ¥8,000.
An August 2026 diner called the sea urchin the best of half a century of eating.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区室町通蛸薬師上ル鯉山町535 室蛸ビル 1F、四条駅から徒歩5分、昼12:00〜14:00 (最終入店12:30)、夜18:00〜22:00 (最終入店19:30)、火曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可 (昼と飲み放題はカード不可)、20席 (カウンター6、座敷12)、半個室、2011年4月21日オープン。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年11月、英語): 昼のコース3,500円・4,400円、夜5,800円・7,700円、夏は鱧のコース6,000円と8,000円、松茸の土瓶蒸し、ちりめん山椒のご飯、自家製のデザート、月替わりの献立、京都の地酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a set course; dishes are explained (October 2025); tatami seating suits families (June 2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_junidanya_hanamikoji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: sukiyaki with udon in the pot (December 2025), a tempura rice bowl (Tabelog category; January 2026) and soy-based sauces. For shabu-shabu, ask about the sesame and ponzu sauces.
kyoto_junidanya_hanamikoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef house; even the yuba soy-milk hot pot set came with simmered beef and a dashi omelette (January 2026).
kyoto_junidanya_hanamikoji.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–20:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); waits of 15–30 min at 18:00 (October 2025, February 2026). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). 55 seats with tatami; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Hanamikoji; 5 min east of Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). The separate main shop, four doors east, took groups of two or more only (December 2025).
kyoto_junidanya_hanamikoji.notes: [Shabu-shabu · Gion Hanamikoji, where beef shabu-shabu began] The Hanamikoji branch of Junidanya, whose second-generation owner devised beef mizutaki — now known as shabu-shabu — in 1949, and opened this shop as a more casual one (official site). A ¥3,800 set brings three slices of marbled beef for your own pot with sesame sauce or ponzu; the sukiyaki set (¥4,200) is the other favourite. No reservations — expect a short wait at dinner. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (junidanya-kyoto.com): 「牛肉の水炊き(しゃぶしゃぶ)発祥の店」. In 1949 (昭和24年) the second-generation owner, advised by a doctor friend from Tottori (吉田璋也) and others, devised beef mizutaki, which became the shabu-shabu known across Japan. The same owner opened the Hanamikoji shop to make it easier to drop in; the main shop is four doors east, and the site marks the two as separate shops.
chef_bio.specialty: Shabu-shabu with house sesame sauce; beef sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner dipped the beef mostly in the sesame sauce and kept the milder ponzu for the vegetables.
An August 2026 diner noted that every other customer was from overseas, and several staff too.
A December 2025 diner, turned away from the main shop as a party of one, came here instead for shabu-shabu with simmered beef and Kyoto yuba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 牛肉の水炊き(しゃぶしゃぶ)発祥の店、昭和24年に二代目が鳥取の医師 吉田璋也らの助言で考案、二代目がより気軽にと花見小路店を出店、本店はその四軒東で別店舗。食べログ: しゃぶしゃぶ・鍋・天丼、東山区祇園町南側570-240、祇園四条から徒歩5分、11:30〜14:00・17:00〜20:00、水木休み、予約不可、カード・PayPay 可、55席、座敷、貸切20〜50名。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年8月、英語): しゃぶしゃぶ定食3,800円 (肉3枚、ごまだれ・ぽん酢、両方で200円増し)、追加の肉900円から、すき焼き御膳4,200円、湯葉の豆乳鍋、黒毛和牛ロースの瓦焼き、だし巻き、牛の煮物、外国人の客と店員が多い、夕方は15〜30分待ち。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in and wait; set meals with your own pot, and staff explain how long to simmer (December 2025). Many overseas guests and several overseas staff (August 2026).

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_pontocho_fujita.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki courses include tempura, nama-fu (wheat gluten) and grilled fu (August 2025, July 2026); no gluten information.
kyoto_pontocho_fujita.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the cooking rests on a kombu and katsuobushi dashi (Tabelog, shop text); fish and meat courses.
kyoto_pontocho_fujita.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last food order 12:00), dinner 17:30–21:30 (last food order 19:00); closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). Tabelog still notes a closure until mid-April 2026 after a fire next door; reviews from June to October 2026 show it open again. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 50 seats at a counter and in private and tatami rooms (Tabelog); shoes off at the entrance (July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Pontocho south of Sanjo, facing the Pontocho Kaburenjo (September 2025); 4 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_fujita.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Pontocho, facing the Kaburenjo] A kaiseki house on Pontocho opposite the Kaburenjo theatre, where the head chef shops the central market every morning and builds everything on a two-hour kombu-and-bonito dashi. Lunch courses from about ¥8,000, dinner around ¥12,000; seats at the counter, where the chef talks with guests, or in window rooms upstairs. One May 2025 diner found the meat and grilled fish weaker than the rest. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), who goes to the central market each morning (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Kyoto cuisine centred on dashi from ma-kombu and two kinds of Rishiri kombu, steeped at 60°C for two hours with katsuobushi added quickly; seafood from Setouchi and Kyushu through a fishmonger of more than 20 years; private rooms for business and celebrations; an online shop sells roast beef of Kyoto beef round coated in tencha tea leaves from Wazuka, Uji.
chef_bio.philosophy: Dashi as the essence of every dish, drawing out the ingredients’ own flavour (Tabelog, shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki courses; hamo in season.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner found the head chef friendly and easy to talk to; most guests were from overseas and were served well in English.
A September 2025 diner ate in a second-floor private room looking out on the Pontocho Kaburenjo, a filming location of the film “National Treasure”.
An October 2026 diner was served hamo described as “the best at this time of year” and found it remarkably fluffy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区先斗町通三条下る材木町179-2、三条駅から徒歩4分、昼11:30〜14:00・夜17:30〜21:30、月火休み、隣の店の火事で2026年4月中旬まで休業との記載、予約可、カード可 (電子マネー・QR 不可)、50席、個室、禁煙。店の紹介 (英訳): 3種の昆布を60℃で2時間、鰹節で引く出汁、料理長が毎朝中央市場へ、20年以上の付き合いの魚屋から Setouchi と Kyushu の魚介、昼と夜の懐石とアラカルト、8品のコース12,000円、てん茶をまぶしたローストビーフの通販。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 歌舞練場の向かい、2階の個室、料理長と話せる、英語での対応 (2025年5月)、肉と焼き魚は今ひとつ (2025年5月)、常連が多く落ち着かない日も (2025年7月)、鱧の天ぷらと揚げ物、ほうじ茶のジェラート。

cultural_comfort.note: A May 2025 diner reported most guests were from overseas and were served well in English; the head chef chats at the counter. Shoes off; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (closure notice to mid-April 2026 after a neighbouring fire); reviews dated June–October 2026 show it reopened.

kyoto_gion_saryo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bakery café built around thick toast of its house-baked bread, with cakes and hot sandwiches (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_saryo.vegan_detail: Ask. Teas and lattes can be made with soy milk (August 2026), but the bread sets come with butter and egg salad; nothing vegan is marked (official menu; reviews).
kyoto_gion_saryo.hours_raw: Weekdays 9:00–15:30; Saturday and Sunday 8:00–16:30 (Tabelog); the official site gives 9:00–17:00 (last order 16:30). Closing days are posted monthly on the official site. No service or cover charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料・チャージ なし」). The bread sets are limited to about 20–30 a day, so come early (November 2025; March 2026). Seating on two floors, including sofas; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX), transit IC, iD and QR (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Whole-building hire with food for groups (official site). A renovated storehouse about 100 years old in front of the south gate of Yasaka Shrine; about 5 min from the Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop (official site). Opened 1 August 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_saryo.notes: [Café · Yasaka Shrine, thick toast in an old storehouse] A two-floor café in a century-old storehouse facing the south gate of Yasaka Shrine, open from 8:00 at weekends — handy before the crowds. The draw is a chewy house-baked loaf served thick with butter, egg salad, yuzu jam or sweet bean paste, plus soup and salad; only 20–30 sets a day. Matcha espresso and Ippodo hōjicha lattes for later. Upstairs looks out toward the shrine. Closing days vary; check the site.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a select tea house that aims to hand Kyoto’s history and culture down to the next generation (its theme is "紡ぐ", to spin a thread); a renovated storehouse about 100 years old near the main gate of Yasaka Shrine, with 13 staff in 2023 (recruiting page). The loaf 蔵出し食パン is baked in the shop’s own workshop. Opened 1 August 2020 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to spin Kyoto’s history and culture into the future.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick toast of the house-baked 蔵出し食パン.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor who came at 8:00 near Yasaka Shrine got one of the roughly 30 bread sets.
An August 2026 guest had the matcha espresso made with soy milk.
An April 2026 pair wished the only dessert option, a three-cake set, could be varied.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-saryou.kyoto): 京都祇園茶寮、京都の文化を世界に伝えるセレクト茶寮、テーマは京都の想いを後世に紡ぐこと、八坂神社南楼門前、東山区祇園町南側506、9:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、市バス東山安井から徒歩約5分、定休日は毎月お知らせ、一棟まるごとプラン。メニュー: 焼きたて蔵出し食パン、季節のサラダ、お目覚めスープ、山椒コンビーフのホットサンド、パティシエのおすすめケーキ3種とドリンク、八十八良葉舎の抹茶ラテ、一保堂のほうじ茶ラテ、抹茶エスプレッソ、ムレスナティー。求人 (2023年): 築100年の蔵を改装、スタッフ13名。食べログ: カフェ・パン、平日9:00〜15:30、土日8:00〜16:30、サービス料・チャージなし、カード・交通系IC・iD・QR 可、禁煙、2020年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年9月、英語): 食パン1,380円、抹茶とプレーンの食パン2,650円、1日20〜30食、抹茶エスプレッソ1,080円、豆乳に変更可。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas visitors in the morning; order at the counter.

existence.note: Official site (closing-day notices 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_yayoi_comodo.gf_detail: Ask. The ojako is chirimen-jako simmered in soy sauce, and the udon is wheat; warabi-mochi and green tea are also served; no gluten information is published (official site).
kyoto_yayoi_comodo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the meals are built on chirimen-jako (baby sardines), and the udon broth is made from the simmered ojako (official site).
kyoto_yayoi_comodo.hours_raw: Café 9:30–15:00 (last order 14:00); closed Tuesday, Wednesday and irregularly (official café page). Tabelog instead lists eat-in at weekends and holidays 9:30–14:00 — check before going. The shop itself is open 9:30–17:00 daily except 1–2 January (official site; Tabelog). Ojako-zen is limited to 12 a day; matcha warabi-mochi from 11:00 while it lasts (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 12 places on floor cushions in the back, past the shop counter (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and QR (Tabelog). In the はなれ behind the main shop, about 100 m south of the south gate of Yasaka Shrine on Shimogawara-dori (official site). The café opened in 2004 and was renamed やよいComodo on 1 October 2026 (official site).
kyoto_yayoi_comodo.notes: [Café · Yasaka Shrine, Kyoto's chirimen-sansho in a back-room café] Behind the sales counter of Yayoi, a Gion maker of chirimen-sansho (baby sardines simmered with Japanese pepper), a small floor-cushion room serves the house ojako as a set meal with rice from an iron hagama, soup and dashimaki (¥1,100, 12 a day), or in a sweet fox udon. In summer there is sansho shaved ice. Buy a bag of ojako on the way out — a classic Kyoto souvenir. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Founder, per Tabelog’s official introduction; company head 代表取締役 中西 良仁 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the founder was a former cook who began making ojako at the family home in 1982; it spread as a gift among the tea houses of Gion; 有限会社やよい was set up in 1988, the main shop opened on Shimogawara-dori by Yasaka Shrine in 1994, a factory followed, and the café opened in the はなれ behind the shop in 2004; shops in Isetan Kyoto (2002) and Shinjuku, and department-store fairs nationwide; 65 staff. Tabelog’s official introduction names the founder Katsuji Nakanishi, who wondered what could be made with one pot, and says the founder’s son now selects the chirimen-jako from Kyushu and Shikoku, paired with Tanba sansho.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "美味しい物は素材が全て" — good food is all in the ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Ojako-zen; ojako chirimen-sansho.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular of 30 years bought eight bags of ojako, then ate it in the back with fresh rice and miso soup.
A July 2026 visitor tried the sansho shaved ice, topped with fruit and a sansho-yuzu syrup, with matcha on the side.
A February 2025 customer who first tried the ojako about 20 years ago found that the shop now serves meals as well.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yayoi-ojako.co.jp): ちりめん山椒 京佃煮舗 やよい、初代は元調理人、1982年創業、1988年有限会社やよい設立、1994年八坂神社下河原通りに本店、2001年本社工場、2002年 JR京都伊勢丹、2004年本店奥 (はなれ) にカフェ併設、2007年伊勢丹新宿店、代表取締役 中西良仁、従業員65名、「美味しい物は素材が全て」。カフェ「やよいのはなれ Comodo」: 祇園下河原清井町481 (八坂神社南楼門を南へ100m)、9:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、火・水・不定休、おじゃこ膳1,100円 (1日12食)、やよいの甘きつねうどん1,210円 (おじゃこのおにぎり付)、山椒氷880円 (夏季)、抹茶わらび餅1,100円 (清水 monna)、山椒トニック660円、一保堂のグリーンティ550円。2026年10月1日にやよいカフェから「やよいComodo」に改称。食べログ: やよい 本店、その他、9:30〜17:00、イートインは土日祝9:30〜14:00、1月1・2日休み、12席 (座布団)、カード・QR 可、公式紹介: 創業者 Katsuji Nakanishi、息子がちりめんじゃこを九州・四国から選び丹波の山椒と合わせる。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 奥のイートイン、炊きたてご飯とおじゃこ、山椒氷。

cultural_comfort.note: English pages on the official site; staff are warm with regulars and tourists alike.

existence.note: Official site (café renamed 1 October 2026; news November 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sushi_fukagawa.gf_detail: Ask. Each piece comes pre-seasoned with salt or soy sauce, and the rice is cooked in katsuobushi dashi; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_sushi_fukagawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: omakase sushi, with rice cooked in katsuobushi dashi (Tabelog official course descriptions).
kyoto_sushi_fukagawa.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 14:00); dinner 16:00–21:00 (last entry 19:00); open daily (Tabelog). Omakase courses only on weekends (October 2026); bookings advised. No service charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料なし」). 12 counter seats; private hire for up to 12; non-smoking; children welcome, kids’ menu, strollers OK; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transit IC, iD, QUICPay and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Many overseas guests (December 2025; October 2026). A machiya with a noren near Teramachi-Ebisugawa, 488 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; August 2025). Opened 1 March 2013 as 寿司 深川龍丈 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_fukagawa.notes: [Sushi · Teramachi-Ebisugawa, dashi-cooked rice in a machiya] A twelve-seat counter in a quiet machiya north of City Hall, where the rice is cooked in katsuobushi dashi and every piece arrives already seasoned with salt or soy. Omakase runs from about ¥9,500 at lunch to ¥28,500 at night: Niigata tuna, Akashi sea bream, kama-toro, Hokkaido uni and a melting grilled anago to finish. Popular with overseas visitors. Open daily; book ahead.

roles: Owner-chef not named; works with an apprentice (October 2026); operator 株式会社ふかがわ (invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 1 March 2013 under the former name 寿司 深川龍丈; a sushi-only course using rice cooked in katsuobushi dashi and carefully chosen fish. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ふかがわ (head office in 東山区泉涌寺門前町). An October 2026 reviewer was served by the chef and an apprentice.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: traditional sushi made with care in a calm setting, a short step from the city’s bustle.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase nigiri on dashi-cooked rice; grilled anago.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner heard from the chef that grilled anago is the hardest piece to make and the chef’s own favourite.
A December 2025 guest found the owner curt with newcomers but chatty with regulars, and still recommended a visit.
A May 2026 birthday guest, a sushi novice, noticed the hidden knife work on the white and silver-skinned fish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿斗 ふかがわ (旧店名 寿司 深川龍丈)、寿司・日本料理・かに、中京区松本町576-2 ルレーブ寺町夷川、京都市役所前駅から488m、12:00〜15:00 (最終入店14:00)、16:00〜21:00 (最終入店19:00)、サービス料なし、カウンター12席、12名まで貸切可、禁煙、子供可・キッズメニュー、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay・WeChat Pay 含む) 可、2013年3月1日オープン、インボイス T7130001045628 (株式会社ふかがわ)。コース: 昼のおまかせ15,500円、夜のおまかせ23,000円・28,500円、鰹節の出汁で炊いたシャリ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昼のおまかせ9,500円、13貫8,800円、一貫ごとに塩や醤油で味付け、新潟の鮪、明石の鯛、カマトロ、北海道の雲丹、穴子、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests; pieces come pre-seasoned.

kyoto_daishime.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood marinated in soy, fried horse mackerel, shumai, eel wrapped in bread and somen; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_daishime.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fishmonger’s seafood omakase (reviews).
kyoto_daishime.hours_raw: Thursday, Friday and Saturday 16:30–20:00; closed Sunday–Wednesday (Tabelog). Extremely hard to book: reviewers in 2026 report waits of about a year, and many evenings are booked whole by groups (April–August 2026). Omakase of about ¥10,000; bring-your-own alcohol with a ¥500 corkage per bottle, and self-service drinks (April–July 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). By the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market, 365 m from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_daishime.notes: [Seafood · Central Wholesale Market, the hardest-to-book fish izakaya] A fishmonger's izakaya beside Kyoto's wholesale fish market, open only Thursday to Saturday evenings and booked about a year out. For around ¥10,000 the chef piles on the market's best: crab, a tasting of five rare tuna cuts, uni with tuna in nori, firefly squid, eel shumai and sakura-shrimp rice. Bring your own bottle (¥500 corkage) and pour your own drinks. Cash only.

roles: Chef-owner not named; a fishmonger at the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market (reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe it as run by a fishmonger from the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market who buys the fish there each day, with a cheerful, talkative chef and very generous portions (2025–2026 reviews). Tabelog gives no opening date.
chef_bio.specialty: Five-cut rare tuna tasting; uni and tuna wrapped in nori.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 first-timer, in on a friend’s private booking, heard the next open date was a year away.
A July 2026 regular on a sixth visit noted the corkage was still ¥500 a bottle.
A regular who travels about two hours to come says shy guests are soon won over by the chef’s charm (October 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: だいしめ、魚介料理・居酒屋、下京区朱雀宝蔵町44、梅小路京都西駅から365m、木・金・土16:30〜20:00、日〜水定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、サービス料の記載なし。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都中央卸売市場の魚屋が営む居酒屋、予約は1年待ち、貸切の会が多い、おまかせ1万円ほど、持ち込みは1本500円、ドリンクはセルフ、蟹、いくら豆腐、鮪の希少部位5種、2種の雲丹と鮪の海苔巻き、ホタルイカの醤油漬け、なめろう、鯵フライ、鰻の焼売、さんま巻き、オクラそうめん、しらすと桜海老のご飯。

cultural_comfort.note: Booked about a year ahead; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_la_famille_morinaga.gf_detail: Ask. Courses only; homemade bread of Hokkaido and French flour served with every course; dishes include gratins, quenelles and fried items (2023–2026 reviews). The shop asks guests to mention disliked foods and allergies when booking (official site).
kyoto_la_famille_morinaga.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set French courses of fish, foie gras, game and beef, with butter and cream; some dishes use dashi (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_la_famille_morinaga.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 19:30), Tuesday–Saturday; closed Sunday and Monday, when private hire for 8–12 is possible from ¥8,500 a head (official site; Tabelog). Courses only; tell the shop about disliked foods or allergies when booking (official site). Reservations by phone or online; parties of 5 or more and the private room by phone (official site). No service charge (Tabelog, original サービス料なし). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners per Tabelog; the site says cards accepted). No children under 12 except with private hire — consult the shop (Tabelog; official site). Smart casual recommended (Tabelog). No flash or noisy photography; non-smoking (official site). 12 table seats on the ground floor, a private room for 4–6 upstairs (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya off Shinmachi on Takoyakushi, 10 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_la_famille_morinaga.notes: [French · Shinmachi, a family restaurant in a machiya] A warm little French restaurant in a renovated old machiya with a white-gravel garden, run by chef Masahiro Morinaga — trained at Chez Ino in Tokyo and in France, later executive chef at Mikuni Nagoya and Grand Maison Graciani in Kobe — as a family restaurant. One daily course of Kyoto-seasonal French with homemade bread; dinner about ¥12,000, no service charge. No children under 12; smart casual.

chef_bio.background: Per an October 2025 review: drawn to cooking by a love of food and a family restaurant background; graduated from a Kyoto culinary school; trained six years at “Chez Ino” in Tokyo under Akira Inoue; in France from 1993 at Guy Savoy (Paris), a Bordeaux restaurant, Troisgros (Roanne) and a Swiss restaurant; back in Japan in 1997; executive chef of “Mikuni Nagoya” at the Nagoya Marriott Associa from 2003, then of “Grand Maison Graciani” in Kobe; opened La famille Morinaga in Kyoto in 2013. Tabelog’s shop text confirms Chez Ino, a three-Michelin-star restaurant in France and Grand Maison Graciani. The name, “the Morinaga family”, was inspired by the Troisgros family (October 2025). A June 2026 diner found “the couple running the place exude warmth”.
chef_bio.philosophy: A warm family restaurant passed down like Troisgros (October 2025); fresh seasonal ingredients in a single daily course (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal French course; homemade bread.

anecdotes.text: A September 2023 diner noted the bread: Hokkaido wheat blended with French flour and Guérande salt.
A June 2026 lunch guest was served corn soup with corn sorbet and truffle-scented popcorn hidden under the bowl.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: La famille Morinaga、ランチ11:30〜14:30 (L.O.13:00)、ディナー18:00〜22:00 (L.O.19:30)、日・月定休 (貸切は8〜12名、1人8,500円から)、料理はコースのみで苦手な食材やアレルギーは事前に、全席禁煙、フラッシュや音の出る撮影はお断り、子どもは相談、カード可。食べログ: フレンチ、中京区蛸薬師通新町西入不動町175-5、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩10分、サービス料なし、1階テーブル12席・2階個室4〜6名、12歳未満は入店不可 (貸切なら可)、スマートカジュアル、店の紹介: 東京の Chez Ino とフランスの三つ星で修業し、神戸の Grand Maison Graciani の総料理長を務めたシェフ、日替わりのコースのみ。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): シェフ Masahiro Morinaga、1993年に渡仏、2013年に開店、夫婦で営む、ディナー12,000円、自家製パン。

cultural_comfort.note: Course only; tell the shop about allergies when booking. No children under 12 (private hire excepted); smart casual; no flash photography.

kyoto_neo_pasta_yamauchi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade fresh pasta of domestic whole-wheat flour, the noodle shape matched to each sauce (October 2025; January 2026).
kyoto_neo_pasta_yamauchi.vegan_detail: Ask. Sauces include bonito dashi, mentaiko, white-miso carbonara with bacon and hamburg steak; a Kyoto-pickle pasta and seasonal vegetable pastas exist, but the makeup of those sauces is not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_neo_pasta_yamauchi.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–20:00 (Tabelog lists every day; a July 2026 reviewer mentions regular closing days — check). Reservations accepted; weekend tables can be full (July 2026). Cards, e-money and QR codes (Tabelog). 15 seats, counter and tables (Tabelog; November 2025). Non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog). On a side street near Karasuma Oike, between Karasuma Oike and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stns (Tabelog). Opened 26 November 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_neo_pasta_yamauchi.notes: [Fresh pasta · near Karasuma Oike, Kyoto-style sauces] A small counter-and-table room making chewy fresh pasta from domestic whole-wheat flour, with the noodle shape matched to the sauce and a Kyoto accent: white-miso mentaiko carbonara, bonito-dashi pasta with shiso, Kyoto pickle pasta, Kamo eggplant in summer. Sets around ¥1,000–2,000 with salad. Portions on the small side. Solo-friendly; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers note the shop has appeared on television (May and July 2026); a July 2026 reviewer writes that it opened “about five years ago”, while Tabelog gives November 2022.
chef_bio.philosophy: Changing the noodle type and shape to suit the sauce (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh pasta with Kyoto flavours.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 visitor, walking back from the Jidai Matsuri, found the room nearly full of festival-goers from Europe and America.
A July 2026 diner had kept arriving on closing days before finally getting in.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ネオパスタヤマウチ、パスタ、中京区観音町85-1、烏丸御池駅・京都市役所前駅から徒歩、11:30〜14:00、17:30〜20:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、15席、禁煙、英語メニュー、2022年11月26日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 国産全粒粉の自家製生パスタ、ソースに合わせて麺を変える、白味噌の明太子カルボナーラ、鰹出汁のパスタ、京漬物のパスタ、Kamo なすの冷製パスタ、ハンバーグのトマトソース、量は少なめ、テレビで紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); many overseas diners at festival time (October 2025).

kyoto_masugataya_demachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon and soba in soy-based dashi; saba sushi is the one non-noodle dish, seasoning not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_masugataya_demachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based udon and soba with kamaboko, mackerel sushi, herring soba. Tabelog’s shop note says vegetarian dishes can be prepared on request — ask.
kyoto_masugataya_demachi.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog); ends when sold out — staff close the line with a last group (October 2026). No reservations except for saba sushi (Tabelog). Queues from before opening; waits of 20 minutes to an hour (2026 reviews); six tables for four, no sharing — even solo diners get a table (August 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; August 2026). Tabelog lists smoking as allowed (pre-2020 note). Parking at the municipal Demachi lot. In the shopping street on Masugata-dori at Demachi, 5 min from Keihan Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_masugataya_demachi.notes: [Saba sushi and udon · Demachi shopping street, lunch only] A long-running diner in the shopping street on Masugata-dori at Demachi, open only 12:00–15:00, where the line forms before noon for thick, vinegared saba sushi with a bowl of thin, soft udon in gentle Kyoto dashi (set from ¥1,300). Six tables, no sharing, slow turnover — expect to wait up to an hour; it closes the line when stock runs out. PayPay or cash. A July 2026 reviewer suggests pairing it with Futaba.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a long-established diner with a well-worn gas stove (August 2026) that prides itself on fresh saba sushi (August 2026). No owner is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Saba sushi; udon.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, in line at 12:30, was in the last group: staff came out, announced it, and took down the noren.
A July 2026 visitor recommended pairing the meal with Futaba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 満寿形屋、食堂・寿司・うどん、上京区桝形通出町西入ル二神町179、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩約5分、河原町今出川バス停から徒歩約3分、12:00〜15:00、水曜定休、予約不可 (鯖寿司のみ可)、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、24席 (4人掛け6卓)、テイクアウト、店の案内: 季節の食材やメニューにない日替わり、ベジタリアン対応も相談可、地酒と焼酎。口コミ (2026年、英語): 厚い鯖寿司、細くやわらかいうどん、きつねうどんセット1,500円、かけうどんと鯖寿司1,300円、松茸と鯖寿司2,500円、にしんそば、開店前から行列、相席なし、売り切れで暖簾を下ろす。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue outside from before noon; order a set; no sharing tables. PayPay or cash only.

kyoto_mr_maurices_italian_ace.gf_detail: Ask. Wood-fired pizza, homemade pasta, focaccia with cheese fondue and tiramisu; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_mr_maurices_italian_ace.vegan_detail: Ask. A Kyoto-vegetable pizza and salads appear, but most dishes use cheese, sausage, salami, beef or seafood; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mr_maurices_italian_ace.hours_raw: Weekdays and the day before a holiday 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; weekends and holidays 11:30–22:00 with tea 15:00–17:30; last order 21:30; open year-round; two dinner sittings on 24–25 December and 30 December–2 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, phone 11:30–21:30 (Tabelog). A 10% service charge, included in displayed prices (Tabelog original サービス料10％（表示価格に含む）). 170 seats: 96 indoors incl. a 12-seat bar counter, and a rooftop of 74 with an 18-seat bar; partitions but no private rooms; non-smoking indoors (Tabelog). Dogs welcome on the rooftop terrace (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards (Tabelog). 3F of Ace Hotel Kyoto in Shinpuhkan, directly connected to Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_mr_maurices_italian_ace.notes: [Italian · Ace Hotel Kyoto, rooftop terrace by Karasuma Oike] The Ace Hotel Kyoto's big, casual Italian-American osteria, with a Marc Vetri menu: wood-fired pizzas with Kyoto vegetables, homemade pastas such as cacio e pepe and rigatoni with sausage ragù, tagliata and tiramisu — plus a breezy rooftop bar and terrace where dogs are welcome. Lunch sets and courses; prices include 10% service. One September 2026 guest found the staff cold; most praise the service. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: Mr. Maurice's Italian at Ace Hotel Kyoto, supervised by the Italian chef Mark Vetri (as Tabelog writes it), offers wood-fired pizza, homemade pasta and courses in a refined room and an open rooftop. An October 2026 reviewer notes the building, over 100 years old, was redesigned by Kengo Kuma for Ace Hotel, and that course prices have risen over 40% since opening.
chef_bio.philosophy: A modern twist on classic flavours (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired pizza; cacio e pepe.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest brought the dog Flora to the rooftop terrace and found many other dogs there too.
A September 2026 visitor came for a Harlow ice-cream pop-up, found the staff "rather cold", and questioned ¥1,500 for a small double scoop.
"Although the course prices have increased by over 40% since the opening, the beautiful space designed and rebranded by Kengo Kuma ... offers a wonderful harmony" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・バー・パスタ、中京区車屋町245-2 Ace Hotel Kyoto 3F、烏丸御池駅直結、平日・祝前日 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、土日祝 11:30〜22:00 (ティー15:00〜17:30)、L.O.21:30、無休、予約可、サービス料10% (表示価格に含む)、170席 (屋内96、ルーフトップ74)、禁煙、カード可、Mark Vetri 監修のアメリカンスタイルのイタリアン、薪窯のピッツァ、自家製パスタ、コース、飲み放題、ルーフトップで犬連れも可。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): ランチのパスタセット (ソーセージのラグーのリガトーニ)、京野菜と Hokkaido のモッツァレラのピッツァ、ティラミス、4,050円のランチ (フォカッチャのチーズフォンデュ、カチョエペペ、牛のタリアータ)、茄子のサラダ、クリームパスタ、サラミと京野菜のハーフ&ハーフ、鮭とオマールのグリル、5品のコース、ルーフトップのビアテラス、犬連れのテラス、スタッフの対応が冷たかったとの声、開業時からコースが4割以上値上がり、建物は Kengo Kuma がリデザイン (口コミ)。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel restaurant; prices include 10% service; dogs welcome on the rooftop; cards accepted.

kyoto_kameyama_manabu.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, tempura and rice dishes such as unadon, with soy and dashi; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kameyama_manabu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-sake counter — sashimi, crab, eel and tempura (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kameyama_manabu.hours_raw: Tabelog lists daily 6:00–22:00, but reviewers describe evenings of 18:30–22:00 (April 2026) and a weekday lunch for regulars (2023–2024); hours may change (Tabelog). No first-time customers at lunch or dinner (Tabelog remarks) — reviewers came with someone who knows the shop (2024–2026). Evening courses with all-you-can-drink sake, e.g. the 2-hour "Go Go" course ¥5,500 (June 2025) or ¥9,500 cash (April 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). 14 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). No sign, just a nameplate (October 2023). On Takoyakushi west of Muromachi; 5 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog). Opened 22 April 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kameyama_manabu.notes: [Sake counter · Takoyakushi Muromachi, regulars and friends of regulars] An unmarked fourteen-seat counter near Shijo Karasuma where owner Mr. Kameyama cooks and serves alone: thick sashimi, a whole crab, crisp tempura, with self-pour all-you-can-drink from over forty sakes, about ¥5,500–9,500 in cash. First-time guests are not accepted — you need to come with someone who knows the shop. A Tigers-fan, regulars' kind of place.

roles: Owner, called Mr. Kameyama or Mr. Manabu by reviewers, who runs the shop alone
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 22 April 2016; first-time customers are not accepted at lunch or dinner. A January 2024 reviewer explains that lunch turns away first-timers because the owner runs everything alone; reviewers address the owner as "Mr. Manabu" (March 2024) and "Mr. Kameyama" (June 2025), and describe a sake list of over 40 brands, many from Yamagata (April 2026), and a Tigers-supporting crowd (August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-drink sake courses; thick sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "Finally! Finally! Finally! I was able to visit in the evening!! Thank you, my husband." — March 2024, on a shop that turns away first-timers.
A June 2025 guest watched the owner, Mr. Kameyama, line up an impressive row of sake bottles from the fridge at the start of the "Go Go" course.
"I personally prefer to savor my drinks with care, paying attention to the glassware and sake vessels." — September 2023, on the self-pour sake that warms as it waits.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理・寿司、中京区蛸薬師室町西入る姥柳町192、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、営業時間の表記は毎日 6:00〜22:00、現金のみ、14席 (カウンター)、禁煙、2016年4月22日オープン、昼も夜も一見客は不可。口コミ (2023年9月〜2026年7月、英語): 看板はなく表札だけ、店主一人で営む、ランチは常連向け (特大の鰻丼、木曜の「Tonio Rice」)、夜は18:30〜22:00、日本酒40種以上 (山形の酒が多い) の飲み放題のコース、「Go Go」コース5,500円 (2025年6月)、現金9,500円 (2026年4月)、厚切りのお造り、蟹一杯、さくさくの天ぷら、祭りの夜の屋台で鰻の天ぷら、タイガースのファン。

cultural_comfort.note: No first-time guests — come with someone who knows the shop; cash only.

kyoto_chidoriashi_nijo.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto oden in a sweet-savoury dashi with fish cakes, plus kara-age, eel spring rolls and potato salad; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_chidoriashi_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi with duck and fish cakes, sashimi and meat dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_chidoriashi_nijo.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00; closed Wednesday and some other days each month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — courses by the day before; seat-only bookings on the day if free (Tabelog). 18 seats: 8 at the counter and 10 on tatami in a back room; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking outside; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Oike-dori just south of Nijo Castle, west of Horikawa; 3 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn exit 3 (Tabelog).
kyoto_chidoriashi_nijo.notes: [Oden · south of Nijo Castle, red lantern and warm sake] A small red-lantern izakaya on Oike-dori in front of Nijo Castle: Kyoto oden in a clear, gently sweet broth (daikon, hirousu, duck with Kujo negi, even tomato), a famous potato salad, seasonal sashimi and eel spring rolls, with a broad sake list warmed to order and poured into a cup of your choice. Friendly owner and staff who chat and pour; open to midnight. About ¥4,000–5,000. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a popular izakaya south of Nijo Castle with warm hospitality from the owner and staff, friendly conversation at the counter, staff who pour for solo guests, and a pot of kanzake warming at the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto oden; potato salad; warmed sake.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 couple, whose first-choice oden shop was closed, found the staff so friendly; on praising the food, the couple heard it was the second such compliment that day.
"I was enjoying a bottle of beer by myself, and the staff noticed and kindly poured it for me" — February 2026.
"When you order Japanese sake, you can choose from a variety of small cups, which is a delightful surprise!" — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・肉料理・おでん、中京区堀川御池西入ル大文字町233-6、二条城前駅3番出口から徒歩3分、18:00〜24:00、水曜と月に数日の不定休、予約可 (コースは前日まで、席のみは当日空きがあれば)、18席 (カウンター8、座敷10)、貸切20名まで、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、Wi-Fi、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 二条城の南の御池通、赤提灯と「Chi」の字ののれん、京風のおでん (大根、こんにゃく、ひろうす、鴨と九条ねぎ、トマト)、柚子胡椒、評判のポテトサラダ、お造り、焼き物、万願寺とうがらし、鰻の春巻き、真鯛、冷やし唐揚げ、燗酒、選べるお猪口、日本酒が豊富 (Wakaebisu Plus 006 など)、店主とスタッフの温かいもてなし。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter or tatami; staff recommend dishes; book courses by the day before; cards, e-money and QR.

kyoto_all_day_dining_yasaka_imperial.gf_detail: Ask. A hotel menu of Western classics — hamburg steak, Chaliapin steak, curry, onion gratin soup, pies and bread — plus Japanese breakfast and afternoon tea; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_all_day_dining_yasaka_imperial.vegan_detail: Ask. Fruit desserts appear, but the menu centres on beef, cheese, eggs, dairy and dashi-based breakfast; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_all_day_dining_yasaka_imperial.hours_raw: Daily: breakfast 6:30–10:30 (last order 10:00; Japanese breakfast from 7:00); lunch 11:30–14:30; tea 14:30–17:30; dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Open to non-guests, though the hotel lobby itself is for staying guests (July 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Private rooms (Tabelog). 2F of the main building of the Imperial Hotel Kyoto, next to the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo off Hanamikoji (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 5 March 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_all_day_dining_yasaka_imperial.notes: [Hotel all-day dining · Gion by the Kaburenjo, the new Imperial Hotel] The all-day restaurant of the Imperial Hotel Kyoto, opened in March 2026 in the restored Yasaka Kaikan beside the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo: a breakfast built with dishes from the Gion restaurant Kawakami, lunch courses with hamburg steak, the Imperial's Chaliapin steak and a Yasaka curry, parfaits and fruit skillets at tea, and afternoon tea. Polished, warm service; one September 2026 tea party waited through a muddle over sold-out desserts before the kitchen head stepped in. Open to non-guests. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 5 March 2026 on the second floor of the main building of the Imperial Hotel Kyoto. Reviewers in 2026 describe a hotel that inherits the former Yasaka Kaikan, a breakfast featuring dishes from the Gion restaurant Kawakami (July 2026), Gion- and maiko-inspired dishes (July 2026), and attentive service, with the head of the kitchen and the manager stepping in when an order went wrong (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Chaliapin steak; Yasaka curry; Kawakami breakfast.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 family, hoping for coffee in the lobby, learned it was for hotel guests only and were seated instead at Yasaka on the second floor.
A July 2026 hotel guest had three bowls of rice at breakfast and found the second bowl of miso soup came with different ingredients from the first.

A September 2026 party, told twice that ordered desserts had run out, grew anxious before a Minami-za show — until the head of the kitchen came out, both were served, and the manager added a Ronnefeldt herbal tea.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食、東山区祇園町南側570-289 帝国ホテル 京都 本棟2F、朝食6:30〜10:30 (L.O.10:00、和朝食は7:00から)、ランチ11:30〜14:30、ティータイム14:30〜17:30、ディナー17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、個室あり、2026年3月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 歌舞練場の隣、旧弥栄会館を受け継ぐホテル、ロビーは宿泊客のみ、祇園の料理店「Kawakami」の料理の朝食 (三段の盛り合わせ、からすがれいの西京焼き、だし巻き、ご飯と味噌汁のおかわり)、前菜4種・冷製スープ・ハンバーグ・マンゴーのショートケーキのランチ、シャリアピンステーキ、弥栄カレー、クラシックパイ、季節のフルーツのスキレット、弥栄パフェ、チーズとハムの盛り合わせ、オニオングラタンスープ、ステーキ、アフタヌーンティー (90分の紅茶飲み放題、ビーフシチュー)、ロンネフェルトのハーブティー、デザートの品切れで待たされたが厨房の責任者が対応 (2026年9月)。

kyoto_trattoria_la_voce.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta, lasagna, gnocchi, cannelloni and pizza are the core of the menu (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_trattoria_la_voce.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the lunches seen are cheese-heavy pasta and lasagna and the courses lean on meat and fish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_trattoria_la_voce.hours_raw: Official site: Tue–Sun lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Monday, plus about two irregular Sundays or Tuesdays a month; closed 31 December–1 January and for summer and winter breaks; open days on Instagram. Weekday lunch is the daily special only; weekends and holidays have the regular pasta lunch, and a dinner course at lunch for 2+ booked by the day before (official site; Tabelog). Dinner seat charge ¥500 a person, covering the starter (Tabelog, Japanese original 「席料(つきだしなど)…￥500」). Pairs usually sit at the counter; some plans are limited to two hours (Tabelog). 21 seats — 9 counter, 12 at tables that become private rooms for 4 and 5–8; non-smoking, ashtray outside; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff; small children in private rooms only (Tabelog). Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, Diners); the site also lists PayPay and Rakuten Pay, Tabelog says no QR. Founded in Kuzuha, Osaka on 26 May 2004; moved here 18 March 2009 (official site).
kyoto_trattoria_la_voce.notes: [Italian · Shijo-Karasuma trattoria, since 2009] A 21-seat trattoria two minutes from Karasuma Station — counter, two private rooms and a wine cellar you can walk into. Weekend lunches have antipasto platters and pastas like a Roman duck-and-pork cannelloni; dinner runs to venison and omakase. Some find the portions small (March 2026) or the flavours light (April 2026). ¥500 seat charge at dinner. English menu. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (signs the shop notices "オーナー 山本", official site); chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Trattoria La Voce opened in Kuzuha, Osaka on 26 May 2004 and moved to Shijo-Karasuma on 18 March 2009, marking 20 years in 2024 with a fair signed by the owner, 山本. The name is Italian for "voice" or "opinion": a restaurant full of happy voices that listens to its guests. Since opening it has held to the Italian basic of enjoying the ingredient’s own taste; in 2022 it added a shop for Italian wine and food, alongside department-store events and catalogue sales.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「素材が持つ本来の味を楽しむ」 — enjoy the taste the ingredient already has.
chef_bio.specialty: Lasagna; antipasto platter; pasta lunch.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner, choosing among nine lunches, passed up lasagna and venison ragù: "I might not have another chance to try cannelloni" — duck and pork rolled in sheet pasta.
"While the portions might be a bit small for men, everything was tasty." — March 2026.
An October 2026 diner was won over by the venison — "the subsequent sirloin cap completely faded in comparison."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (lavoce-kyoto.com): Trattoria La Voce (トラットリア ラ・ヴォーチェ)、四条烏丸のイタリアン、2004年5月26日に大阪府樟葉で開業、2009年3月18日に現在地へ移転、創業20周年 (オーナー 山本)、店名はイタリア語で声・意見、「素材が持つ本来の味を楽しむ」、イタリア直送の食材、北海道の“あか牛”、京都の契約農家の野菜、自由に見られるワインセラー、2022年から物販スペース、デリバリーはラザニア・ピッツァ・ライスコロッケ、火〜日 昼12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・夜17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、月曜休み (不定期で日曜か火曜、月2回程度)、平日はピッツァランチのみ、土日祝はパスタランチ、21席 (テーブル12、カウンター9)、カード可、PayPay・楽天ペイ可。食べログ: イタリアン・ビストロ、中京区観音堂町456 シティキャスル四条 1F、ディナーのみ席料 (つきだしなど) 1人500円、2名は原則カウンター、プランにより2時間制、個室2つ、英語メニュー・英語対応、ベジタリアン対応、小さな子供は個室のみ、2009年3月18日オープン。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): ランチは9種1,800〜3,500円、週末のパスタランチ2,800円、さつまいもとゴルゴンゾーラのラザニア、ニョッキ、鴨と豚のカネロニ、海老のビスク、鹿肉、ティラミス、パンナコッタ+600円、男性には量が少なめ、味は軽め、おまかせコース。

kyoto_kaikaikai_shinpukan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried oysters, an oyster and shirako gratin and crab fried rice are on the menu; grilled shellfish may be seasoned with soy (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaikaikai_shinpukan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an oyster and shellfish bar (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kaikaikai_shinpukan.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri and the days before and after holidays 16:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 13:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); 11–15 August 12:00–22:00. 10 counter seats only, standing up to 20; book ahead at weekends (October 2025; February 2026). kyoto_kaikaikai_shinpukan.notes: [Oyster bar · Shinpukan, ten seats behind a yakitori shop] A ten-seat counter for oysters and grilled shellfish hidden at the back of a yakitori shop in Shinpukan, a minute from Karasuma Oike. Oysters from ¥330 (¥220 with a coupon), a steamed shellfish pot finished as risotto, and a solo drinking course. One February 2026 regular found new staff less practised and the oysters overcooked. ¥550 charge a person. English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 September 2025 (Tabelog), inside Kyoto Suehiro-gari, a yakitori shop in the Shinpukan complex, with a grill right in front of the counter and a high ceiling (2026 reviews). A June 2026 diner noted a male chef and young female staff, and regulars and newcomers treated alike.
chef_bio.specialty: Signature steamed shellfish with a risotto finish; oysters.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "Has there been a change in staff?" — the female staff from the year before were gone, and "some of the new staff seemed a bit inexperienced… which may have led to the oysters being overcooked."
"The male chef and the beautiful female staff (students, perhaps?) showed great care" — June 2026.
A January 2026 solo diner got "kind service without any hint of disdain."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼貝とお酒 貝貝貝〜ごひいき〜、居酒屋・海鮮・オイスターバー、中京区場之町586-2 新風館 1F、京都スエヒロガリの中、烏丸御池駅から徒歩1分、平日 16:00〜22:00、土日祝 13:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 21:00、ドリンク L.O. 21:30)、8月11〜15日は12:00〜22:00、カウンター10席のみ (立ち20名)、禁煙、英語・簡体中国語のメニュー、子連れは電話で相談、チャージ550円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2025年9月3日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 焼鳥店の奥、入口がわかりにくい、生牡蠣・焼牡蠣は1個330円 (クーポンで220円)、Miyajima の牡蠣、名物の貝の蒸し物とリゾット+770円、帆立やサザエの焼き物、いくらのだし巻き、牡蠣フライ、大根とフォアグラ、白子と牡蠣のグラタン、エイの刺身、蟹炒飯、ひとり飲みコース、食べ放題、スタッフが変わり牡蠣が焼きすぎという声、親切な接客。

kyoto_mizo_nijo.notes: [Italian · Nijo, natural wine and a Bolognese with onsen egg] A twelve-seat Italian bistro on Senbon-dori, two minutes from Nijo Station: lunch sets from ¥1,800, a ¥3,850 dinner prix-fixe or omakase from ¥6,600, all with natural wine and light-roast coffee. The Bolognese with an onsen egg is the one people mention. Quibbles: small portions, subtle sauces, and tight seats against the wall (2026). One drink a person at dinner; strict cancellation fees. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 21 November 2019 (Tabelog). The official site describes gentle Italian food, natural wines from organic grapes, and specialty coffee from a Synesso espresso machine; pesticide-free open-field vegetables, fish sent direct from the source including kinds rare in Kyoto, and carefully raised meat; a bright front room on Senbon-dori and a calmer room behind. It also sells P Mustard from Pullst Factory and links to Pullst Cafe and べんてん洞.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「優しいイタリア料理と自然派ワインとスペシャルティコーヒーのお店」 — gentle Italian food, natural wine and specialty coffee.
chef_bio.specialty: Bolognese with onsen egg; prix-fixe dinner.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "the gentlest Bolognese I’ve ever had" — though "I would have been even happier if decaf coffee was available."
An October 2026 diner asked for a low-salt option, "and they kindly accommodated my request."
"For some reason, I felt there was a bias towards eggplant dishes on the menu. Overall, the portion sizes were a bit on the smaller side." — September 2026.
A June 2026 lunch guest stayed over an hour and "felt a bit awkward as they kept refilling our water."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (eatarymizo.com): MIZO、優しいイタリア料理と自然派ワインとスペシャルティコーヒーのお店、JR・地下鉄二条駅から北へ徒歩約2分、千本通りに面する、無農薬露地栽培や低農薬の野菜、産地直送の魚、自然派ワインのみ (ボトル5,500円〜、グラス990円〜)、シネッソのエスプレッソマシンで浅煎り、店内でカフェのみは不可、テイクアウト可、テーブル12席、ランチA 1,800円・B 2,700円・C 3,900円、ディナーのプリフィックス3,850円〜、お任せ6,600円〜 (前日までに予約)、アラカルト 前菜1,100円〜・パスタ1,650円〜・メイン2,750円〜・ドルチェ1,100円〜、ディナーはサービス料なしでワンドリンク制、ランチ11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、ディナー17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、木曜休み・不定休、11月は11日と25日の水曜も休み、キャンセル料 (ランチ当日10時以降2,500円、ディナー当日5,500円、お任せは全額)、カード・PayPay可、プルストファクトリーPマスタード販売、プルストカフェとべんてん洞へのリンク。食べログ: イタリアン・カフェ・ワインバー、中京区西ノ京小堀町1-7、12席、禁煙、子供可 (通路狭く、おむつ替えスペースなし)、2019年11月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 温玉のボロネーゼ、しらすと九条ねぎのアーリオ・オーリオ、Yamagata の豚のラグー、鰆のカルパッチョ、帆立と雲丹のクリーム、洋梨のタルト、減塩に対応、デカフェなし、量は少なめ、茄子が多い、ソースは控えめ、壁側の席が狭い、水を何度も注がれて気まずい。

kyoto_minoriko.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: courses include wild-vegetable tempura and dishes in soy-based dashi (2018–2025 reviews).
kyoto_minoriko.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-based course of fish, fugu, hamo, karasumi and uni (reviews).
kyoto_minoriko.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday and irregularly. 22 seats — a counter downstairs and tables upstairs (Tabelog; July 2026); non-smoking; children welcome; cards, no e-money or QR. Tabelog lists no service charge. Courses: ¥10,000 (2018); ¥8,800 (2023; given on request in March 2025, when online booking started at ¥11,000); ¥13,200 (July 2025). Sake is poured to match each dish at no premium — a July 2025 diner paid ¥18,480 for the ¥13,200 course, a beer and six cups (reviews). Serai (published October 2017): counter 6, tables 8; small cups of sake from ¥400, 100 ml from ¥600; reservations needed.
kyoto_minoriko.notes: [Kaiseki & sake · Oshikoji, a chef who pours to every dish] A Kyoto course-and-sake house near Karasuma Oike, at Shinmachi-Oike for 32 years before moving to Oshikoji: the chef, cooking for over fifty years, pairs a cup from 100-plus sakes — Aramasa, Jikon, Juyondai — to each dish, and charges for sake at everyday prices. Fresh yuba mousse and karasumi on mochi are the signatures. Courses ¥8,800–13,200. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Serai (published October 2017): after 32 years at Shinmachi-Oike, it moved to Oshikoji-dori and added a refrigerator for over 100 sakes, keeping its style of recommending a sake for each dish. A July 2025 reviewer names the owner as Mr. Minoru Kaneko, with 51 years of cooking, and says he stores and ages a large stock of sake in a warehouse in Shiga; a February 2025 regular puts it at over 50 years and says the head chef cooks and pairs the sake personally. A 2024 diner wondered whether a couple runs it; another mentioned a kind hostess.
chef_bio.philosophy: Reviewers (2018–2025): sake is charged without a premium, so rare bottles cost about the same as ordinary ones.
chef_bio.specialty: Sake pairing; fresh yuba; homemade karasumi.

anecdotes.text: A February 2018 first-timer had a beer and seven cups including junmai daiginjo and was charged about ¥14,000 all in — "I was so shocked that I asked the chef to repeat it (laughs)."

February 2025: the first dish came in a vessel by a craftsman newly named a Living National Treasure — "the way the chef casually explained it after I finished eating shows his depth of knowledge from over 50 years in the field."
On a quiet Wednesday in March 2025 the chef sent out a grilled sea-bream head on the house; the couple also found the salted cherry leaves "saltier than expected."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 味野里香 (Minori Ka)、日本料理・日本酒バー、中京区押小路通衣棚西入上妙覚寺町208-6、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日曜休み・不定休、22席、禁煙、子供可、カード可。サライ (2017年10月公開): 味野里香 (みのりこ)、新町御池で32年営んだのち押小路通へ移転、100種類以上の日本酒の専用冷蔵庫、料理に合う日本酒を薦める、日本酒 小400円〜・中 (100ml) 600円〜、鱧の造り・焼き霜・落とし、鰻の白焼きと松茸、鯛茶漬け、要予約、カウンター6席・テーブル8席。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): 店主 Minoru Kaneko 氏、料理歴51年、懐石と居酒屋の間の料理、料理ごとに日本酒を合わせる、日本酒は割高にしない、滋賀の倉庫で日本酒を熟成、生湯葉、自家製からすみの餅巻き、ふぐ皮の煮こごり、ふぐ白子豆腐、山菜の天ぷら、鱧、Akashi の鯛と蛸、Uji の鮎、雲丹の鉄火丼、コース8,800円・10,000円・13,200円、Jikon・Aramasa・Juyondai・Mimuro Sugi・Hanamura・Isojiman・Kuheiji、1階カウンター・2階テーブル、約10年前に移転、女将の心遣い。

kyoto_yumcha_bar_sinsin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: dim sum in wheat wrappers — xiao long bao, shumai, shrimp dumplings, wontons — and spring rolls (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_yumcha_bar_sinsin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat and seafood dim sum menu — shrimp dumplings, shrimp chili, mapo tofu, steamed chicken (2024–26 reviews). No vegan information.
kyoto_yumcha_bar_sinsin.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00, closed irregularly; some nights may be reservation only, so check ahead (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). CASH ONLY — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 at tables; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking: heated tobacco allowed, paper cigarettes after 22:00 at the shop’s discretion, so children are not admitted unless the place is hired privately (Tabelog). Run by one person, so orders slow down when busy (September and October 2024; May 2025). 5 min from Shijo and Karasuma Stns (Tabelog). Opened 13 July 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yumcha_bar_sinsin.notes: [Dim sum bar · Shijo Shinmachi, Chinese small plates with a drink] A 16-seat bar where one owner-chef, trained in a hotel Chinese kitchen, turns out xiao long bao, shrimp dumplings, spring rolls and mapo tofu in two-piece portions from ¥300, so it is easy to try many things — two ate for under ¥8,000 (November 2025). Shaoxing wine on the side. Cash only; heated tobacco allowed. One person runs it, so it slows when full. 18:00–24:00.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who runs the shop alone (2024–25 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a dim sum bar whose owner-chef trained at a hotel Chinese restaurant; opened 13 July 2011. Reviews from September 2024, October 2024 and May 2025 note it is run by one person.
chef_bio.philosophy: Chinese food in small plates, a little of many things, in a bar anyone can drop into alone (Tabelog, shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Dim sum; mapo tofu; spring rolls.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 diner on a fourth visit took a regular’s tip at the counter — spring rolls and mapo tofu — and found the mapo tofu good enough without rice.
A May 2025 diner found the solo owner so organised that the wait never showed, with dim sum served pre-portioned per person.
An October 2024 diner found the tripe and the Jinhua-ham mushrooms mild, but the five-item appetizer plate and crisp spring rolls excellent.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バル・中華料理・ダイニングバー、中京区四条新町上ル東入ル観音堂町470 道家商事ビル1F、四条駅・烏丸駅から徒歩5分、18:00〜24:00、不定休 (予約のみの日もある)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、16席 (テーブル8、カウンター8)、貸切20名まで、加熱式たばこ可・22時以降は紙巻きも場合により可、子供は貸切時のみ、2011年7月13日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 300円からの点心と創作中華、ホテルの中華料理店で修業した店主、紹興酒。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年8月、英語): 一人で営む、前菜3種1,150円、小籠包2個400円、焼売2個500円、麻婆豆腐、麻婆茄子、春巻き、海老チリ、五目あんかけ炒飯、おこげ、2人で8,000円未満。

cultural_comfort.note: Order small plates at the counter from one owner-chef; cash only; heated tobacco allowed and no children unless booked privately.

kyoto_matt_restaurant_2.gf_detail: Ask. Signature dishes use wheat — the Wagyu cigarette in thin pastry, Kyoto-style rigatoni, apple pie (2024–25 reviews); breadcrumb garnishes (May 2024). No gluten information.
kyoto_matt_restaurant_2.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly Wagyu, duck, octopus and oyster dishes (2024–25 reviews); a king oyster mushroom cappuccino and a seasonal vegetable soup appear, but no vegan information.
kyoto_matt_restaurant_2.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–24:00; Sat, Sun, holidays and the days before and after holidays 12:00–24:00; last order food 22:00, drinks 23:30; closing days vary (Tabelog). Lunch last order 16:00 (Tabelog, shop text). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料15%(税込)」). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 12 seats: 8 at an open-kitchen counter and a 4-seat chef’s table with a ¥10,000 seat fee that includes a special dish from Chef MATT and a glass of Japanese wine each (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome, kids menu; no very casual dress (Tabelog). Basement of 北坂ビル; 4 min from Shijo Stn, 5 min from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 20 April 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_matt_restaurant_2.notes: [Japanese wine bar · Karasuma Gojo, fusion plates in an all-white basement] An all-white basement with a U-shaped counter and Showa pop on the speakers, pouring about 120 Japanese wines — taste before you choose — with fusion plates such as the Wagyu cigarette, aosa risotto and Kyoto-style rigatoni. Lunch on weekends and holidays. Reviewers praise the wine guidance but call it pricey, with a 15% service charge. Open to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (mattjapan.com): MATT JAPAN Inc., founded in Kyoto in 2023, runs Restaurant 1.0 (reworked everyday street food), Restaurant 2.0 (modern Japanese dining, this shop; the site says it was established in Kyoto in April 2023, while Tabelog gives an opening day of 20 April 2024), Restaurant 3.0 (a "gastronomic show" opening in Minato, Tokyo, in August 2026) and W/PIZZA°, and also lists SAMURAI SAUVIGNON, a wine served here (May 2024).
chef_bio.philosophy: "DISCOVER NEW JAPAN": Japanese ingredients such as Kyoto vegetables and Wagyu, combined with world cuisines (Tabelog, shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu cigarette; Japanese wine.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner noted the clash of a stark white room with retro Showa pop, and the chance to sample wines before choosing.
A December 2024 diner found it expensive and was not left full, and was told the knowledgeable wine server held no sommelier qualification.
A May 2025 group booked the night before for a birthday and still got a birthday plate.

cultural_comfort.note: The menu is in English (December 2024) and the shop text says it draws foreign tourists; staff explain the wines (August 2025). 15% service charge.

kyoto_ondorio.gf_detail: Ask. A set six-course menu that has included lasagna, pasta and churros (May and September 2026); no gluten information.
kyoto_ondorio.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: one set course with duck and pâté de campagne (May and September 2026). No vegan information.
kyoto_ondorio.hours_raw: Dinner in two sittings, 17:00–19:00 and 19:30–21:30 (official site); Wed–Sun dinner, plus lunch 12:00–14:00 on Sat, Sun and holidays; closed Monday and Tuesday and some other days each month (Tabelog; official site). Reservation only; seating limited to 2 hours; groups of 4 or more call the shop (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10%」). Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 14 counter seats in a renovated machiya with no sign (Tabelog; March 2026); private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; no children below junior-high age; English menu (Tabelog). Residential street south of Gojo; 8 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 7 December 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ondorio.notes: [Cocktail-paired Italian · Kiyomizu-Gojo, six courses in a machiya] An unsigned machiya with a dim counter, where six seasonal Italian-French dishes each come with a low-alcohol "savory cocktail" — ¥14,800, ¥13,600 with alcohol-free pairings, or ¥9,800 for food alone. Churros with pâté de campagne stood out for one May 2026 diner. Reservation only, two sittings; 10% service charge; no young children. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (ondorio.jp): the name, read オンドリオ, is coined from the story of a boy in one theory of the word “cocktail” — the Mexican rooster’s tail. The food is “genreless”, based on Italian and French cooking, and the drinks are savory cocktails designed to mirror or contrast each dish’s aroma, in what the site calls “Aroma Pairing”. Opened 7 December 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Free thinking and mixing: cooking and making cocktails with the spirit of that boy (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Six-course aroma pairing with cocktails.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner was steered toward soft-drink pairings at first, since the cocktails run about 4–5%, then switched to the alcoholic ones from the second glass.
A May 2026 diner found the churros with pâté de campagne and strawberries a memorable cross of savory and sweet.
A June 2026 diner found the portions too generous and wished for a smaller, cheaper course.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog) and an English official site; book online; one set course, alcohol-free pairing available.

kyoto_kameya_norikatsu.gf_detail: Ask. Wagashi such as warabi mochi with kinako, kuzuyaki, manju and steamed castella layers (2026 reviews); no ingredient information.
kyoto_kameya_norikatsu.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste and starch sweets, but the yomogi dumplings contain egg white (March 2026) and the castella layer of one sweet is egg-based (June 2026).
kyoto_kameya_norikatsu.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sat 9:00–17:00; closed Tuesday and Sunday (Tabelog). Take-away only: sweets are chosen from samples while seated in the traditional style, with no showcase (July and October 2026). Orders by phone; some items such as kuri kinton by reservation (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Sakaimachi north of Sanjo; 395 m from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). Fresh sweets can sell out (March 2026).
kyoto_kameya_norikatsu.notes: [Wagashi · Sakaimachi Sanjo, the clam-shell sweet] An old wagashi house selling in the traditional seated style, from samples rather than a showcase. Known for hamazuto — a real clam shell of yellow jelly over miso-flavoured beans, a tea-ceremony sweet (July 2026) — and, October to about April, a very thin warabi mochi (¥480). Seasonal fresh sweets change through the year. Take-away only; closed Tuesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 御菓子司 亀屋則克, maker of seasonal fresh sweets and dry sweets, whose signature is 浜土産 (はまづと). Reviews give the history differently: moved from Fukui to Kyoto in 1916 (May 2026), founded in 1916 (October 2026), founded in 1926 (July 2026); the founding year is not confirmed here.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamazuto; warabi mochi; seasonal fresh wagashi.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 buyer was told the sweets keep 4–5 days refrigerated and the hamazuto over a week, and heard the shop is favoured by a Kyoto tea teacher.
A June 2026 visitor came for two rainy-season sweets — one of rain and rainbows, one of three green layers — and got both.
An October 2026 buyer carried a box of warabi mochi flat all the way home to Saitama.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 御菓子司 亀屋則克、代表銘菓「浜土産」(はまづと)、中京区堺町通三条上ル、上生菓子とお干菓子。食べログ: 和菓子、中京区堺町通三条上ル大阪材木町702、烏丸御池から395m、月・水〜土 9:00〜17:00、火日休み、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年3月〜9月・10月、英語): 座売り、見本から選ぶ、浜土産は蛤の殻に寒天と浜納豆、わらび餅480円 (10月〜4月頃)、栗きんとん570円 (予約)、水無月3種、よもぎ団子、薯蕷饅頭、三色団子、味噌の柏餅、創業の年は口コミにより1916年と1926年。

cultural_comfort.note: Sit at the front and choose from samples as staff introduce each sweet (June and October 2026); take-away only.

kyoto_forest_zest_oike.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded cutlets, shrimp tempura and fried sets with demi-glace sauce (2026 reviews).
kyoto_forest_zest_oike.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cutlets, hamburg steak and fried meat sets (2026 reviews).
kyoto_forest_zest_oike.hours_raw: 11:00–21:30 (last order 20:00) daily; closed New Year's Day (Tabelog). Phone bookings only during weekday 11:30–13:30 and weekend/holiday 11:30–14:30; no online bookings (Tabelog). Zest Oike gives its restaurants' hours as 11:00–21:00. 13 seats; children and strollers welcome; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR payments; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). In the Zest Oike underground mall, toward the back; 2–3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; May 2026 review).
kyoto_forest_zest_oike.notes: [Yoshoku · Zest Oike underground mall] An old-style Western diner under Kawaramachi-Oike, known for its big waraji katsu in demi-glace — revived, a reviewer says, from a long-gone Kyoto yoshoku house. Lunch sets around ¥1,000–1,500; retro pudding and coffee in the afternoon. Open daily from 11:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 11 December 2010 (Tabelog). An August 2026 reviewer says the waraji katsu revives a dish popular at a long-established Kyoto yoshoku restaurant of the Showa era.
chef_bio.specialty: Waraji katsu with demi-glace.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner had read reviews calling the rice soft but found it fine — "maybe it depends on who cooks it".
Arriving at the 11:00 opening in March 2026, a guest left at noon to find a queue waiting.
A self-described grandpa came in October 2026 after an exhibition at Kyocera Cube for waraji katsu and retro pudding.

cultural_comfort.note: Casual set-meal diner in a shopping mall.
