kyoto_rakkansha.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: cakes, financiers, cookies, pie and butter sand (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_rakkansha.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter, cream, milk and eggs in the cakes and baked goods (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rakkansha.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). The official site says to check its calendar for hours and closures. No bookings; 6 eat-in seats; one drink per person when eating in (April 2026 review). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking. 3–4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 5 (official site; Tabelog). A second counter sells in the JR Kyoto Isetan B1F sweets floor (official site).
kyoto_rakkansha.notes: [Patisserie & tea · near Karasuma Oike] A bright glass-fronted cake shop with six seats, joining Japanese ingredients and French technique: matcha pudding with wasanbon, butter sand made with white bean paste, financiers in a monaka shell (¥200), and seasonal cakes with tea. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 August 2015 (Tabelog). The official site lists the main shop and a counter in JR Kyoto Isetan; its sweets were chosen as Kyoto City hometown-tax gifts.
chef_bio.philosophy: 和魂洋才 (Japanese spirit, Western skill): carefully chosen Japanese ingredients such as matcha, wasanbon and kudzu starch, raised by Western pastry technique (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha pudding; monaka financier; butter sand.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor having sakura mousse was given a free bite of matcha terrine.
An August 2026 customer noticed quite a few international customers in the small eat-in space.
Having bought cookies at the Kyoto Station counter, a visitor found the shop in April 2026 and praised the kind staff.

kyoto_top_of_kyoto_rihga.gf_detail: Ask. French courses with bread and sauces; the hotel asks guests with food allergies to tell staff, and a June 2026 diner said dietary preferences were handled perfectly (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_top_of_kyoto_rihga.vegan_detail: Ask. Courses are fish and meat; dietary requests were accommodated for a June 2026 diner (2026 reviews).
kyoto_top_of_kyoto_rihga.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:30–10:00 (last order 9:30), lunch 12:00–15:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); weekend and holiday lunch in two sittings, 11:30–13:00 and 13:30–15:00; irregular closures, see the official calendar (official site; Tabelog). Breakfast ¥4,301, lunch from ¥7,000, dinner from ¥14,000, tax and service included (official site). Service charge: 15% — Tabelog's Japanese original says 「サービス料15%」. Dress code at dinner: no T-shirts, shorts or sandals. 88 seats, all by the window on a floor that turns 360° in about 90 minutes; two private rooms (2–8 people, extra charge) do not rotate (official site; 2026 reviews). Children welcome; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). 14F of the RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto — change to the restaurant lift on 11F; 7 min walk west of JR Kyoto Stn, or the hotel shuttle bus (official site; August 2026 review).
kyoto_top_of_kyoto_rihga.notes: [Revolving French · RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto, by Kyoto Station] Billed as Japan's only revolving observation French restaurant: every table is at the window as the floor turns once in about 90 minutes past Kyoto Tower, Toji and Higashi Honganji. Lunch from ¥7,000, dinner from ¥14,000 (tax and service included); breakfast too. Popular for anniversaries.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: winner of several cooking competitions, including the 食の都大阪グランプリ; worked at the RIHGA Royal Hotel's 「シャンボール」 and was sous-chef at 「ザ レイ」 before becoming chef here; trained in France at 「ジャンフランソワ ピエージュ」 (Paris, two stars) and 「クリストフ バッキエ」 (now La Table du Castellet, three stars).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal produce and the traditions of French cooking, each plate made with care (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal French courses.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 lunch guest said staff accommodated dietary preferences perfectly.
An August 2026 couple took a private lift up for an anniversary dinner and were each given a single rose.
A September 2026 private-room lunch dragged to three hours; the diner called staff about three times and felt the room was short-staffed.
A July 2026 breakfast guest found the hotel curry, over ¥4,000, just average, and heard the hum of the turning mechanism.

kyoto_panari_kawaramachi_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Tuna bowls with sweet soy sauce, Okinawa soba (wheat), spring rolls; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_panari_kawaramachi_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a tuna and Okinawan izakaya (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_panari_kawaramachi_sanjo.hours_raw: Mon and Fri 17:00–24:00; Tue–Thu, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–24:00; irregular holidays (Tabelog). Bookings online — the phone line was out of order, questions by Instagram DM (Tabelog); seating not guaranteed at busy times. Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「ディナーのみお通し代あり(380円)」 — a ¥380 appetizer fee at dinner only. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Shoes off; counter, sofa seats, sunken kotatsu tables and a loft (Tabelog; September 2026 review). QR ordering and payment (September 2026 review). Cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Up a narrow entrance to the 2nd floor on Kawaramachi north of Sanjo; 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
kyoto_panari_kawaramachi_sanjo.notes: [Tuna & Okinawan izakaya · Kawaramachi-Sanjo] A shoes-off upstairs hideaway with sofa seats and kotatsu tables: bluefin tuna bowls with sea grapes at lunch, tuna platters, goya and Okinawa soba with Orion beer at night, open to midnight. Lunch about ¥1,500; dinner ¥4,000–5,000 with a ¥380 appetizer. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: bluefin tuna bought at the central market, house-made Okinawa soba and rafute, and celebration dessert plates with message cards.
chef_bio.specialty: Bluefin tuna bowls; Okinawan dishes.

anecdotes.text: Arriving at 21:00 after a concert in September 2026, a couple sat with legs stretched at a round kotatsu table; spicy grilled edamame came as the ¥380 appetizer, and the bill for two was ¥8,320.
An October 2026 diner found the Honmaguro bowl's lean tuna dry and the fatty tuna off-colour and smelly — too poor to eat — while the Panari bowl was fine.
In October 2026, when the appetizer turned out to be edamame, staff asked whether a guest wanted to cancel an edamame order.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 本マグロと島ごはん ぱなり 京都河原町三条、居酒屋・沖縄料理・海鮮、中京区河原町通三条上ル恵比寿町534-6 エリゼビル2F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩2分、月金 17:00〜24:00、火水木土日祝 12:00〜24:00、不定休、ディナーのみお通し代380円、40席、喫煙可、中央市場の本マグロ、自家製の沖縄そばとラフテー、昼飲みの飲み放題、ロフト席・ソファ席・掘りごたつ、電話不通のためネット予約・Instagram の DM で問い合わせ。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): ミニ丼2種・3種セット (赤身、ねぎとろ、ほほ肉の炙り、ポキ、海ぶどう)、アーサ汁、マグロの盛り合わせ、ゴーヤー、もずく、QR 注文、靴を脱いで上がる、本マグロ丼の質がひどかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering; shoes off; smoking allowed.

kyoto_tsuruya_soba_hokoda.gf_detail: Ask. A ju-wari (100% buckwheat) ishikurumi soba is on the menu alongside Sarashina soba, but the dipping sauce is soy-and-dashi, and tempura, tendon and fried dishes share the kitchen (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsuruya_soba_hokoda.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based soba sauce and broth; fish tempura, sashimi and dashimaki (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsuruya_soba_hokoda.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30, dinner 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations for dinner only (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 seats: a counter and a tatami area (Tabelog; January 2026). Private dinners for a group of 11 have been held (March 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a quiet residential street on Dotemachi north of Ebisugawa, behind the Ritz-Carlton, about 415 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 7 July 2005 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsuruya_soba_hokoda.notes: [Soba · behind the Ritz-Carlton, a fisherman’s soba house] An eight-seat counter-and-tatami soba shop on a quiet residential street, loved by locals and recommended by hotels. Lunch is a fish tempura bowl with a small bowl of fine handmade soba; at night it turns into a sake-and-small-plates spot with sashimi of fish the owner often catches, ending with Sarashina or ju-wari soba. Cash only; dinner by reservation; closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 regular on a twelfth visit calls the chef a “fishing Meijin” whose own catch often makes it onto the menu. A September 2026 diner learned of the shop from a book by the author Akira Nagai; a May 2026 visitor came on a hotel’s recommendation. A July 2026 diner found the staff unfriendly — a parting thanks went unanswered.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade Sarashina and ju-wari soba; fish tempura bowls.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 solo diner, offered the tatami, asked for the counter instead and the staff cleared a seat.
A May 2025 regular came in after a morning run and a public bath for the ten-nan set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: つるや、そば、中京区土手町通夷川上ル鉾田町299-3、神宮丸太町駅から415m、昼12:00〜14:30、夜18:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、木曜定休、予約は夜のみ、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、8席 (カウンター、座敷)、禁煙、2005年7月7日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): Ritz-Carlton の裏、手打ちの細いそば (更科と十割の Ishikurumi)、日替わりの魚の天丼と小そばのセット、天ざる、とうもろこしの天ぷら、そば茶のプリン、夜は造り、だし巻き、蟹など、珍しい日本酒、店主は釣りの名人で自分で釣った魚も出る、店員が無愛想との声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny local soba shop; cash only; dinner by reservation. Recommended by hotels to guests (May 2026).

kyoto_shirakawa_kyotomi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-battered tempura over rice; nyumen of wheat noodles (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shirakawa_kyotomi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp, conger eel and hamo tempura, dashimaki, dashi broths (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shirakawa_kyotomi.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday and the second Tuesday of the month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted per Tabelog, but not at lunch (April 2026); waits of 30–40 minutes at peak, slow turnover (April 2026). Cards (AMEX) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter and 14 at tables; a private room (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). By the Shirakawa, 142 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 February 2017 (Tabelog).
kyoto_shirakawa_kyotomi.notes: [Tempura bowls · Shirakawa by Higashiyama Stn] A calm lunch-only room steps from Higashiyama Station, handy before Heian Shrine or the KYOCERA Museum: light, crisp tempura bowls of shrimp, anago or hamo, with the tempura on the rice or on its own plate, a fluffy dashimaki (it sells out) and a little sorbet to finish, about ¥2,000–2,600. No lunch bookings; expect a wait at noon. Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: No owner or chef is named in the sources read. Reviewers describe an older local clientele and a calm, slightly formal room (July 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura bowls; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner meant to go to the soba shop next door, saw its line, and came here instead — and got the last dashimaki.
A July 2025 guest was served a rare yellow watermelon after the meal.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 白川 京とみ、天丼、東山区石泉院町393-3、東山駅から142m、火〜日 11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、月曜と第2火曜定休、予約可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー可、20席 (カウンター、テーブル14)、個室あり、禁煙、2017年2月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 海老と穴子の天丼とだし巻き1,980円、海老と鱧の天丼とだし巻き2,580円、天ぷらとご飯を別盛りにもできる、ゆばのにゅうめん、軽い衣、デザートにシャーベット、昼は予約不可で行列、だし巻きは早く売り切れる。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the tempura sets; ask for the tempura served separately if you prefer. Queue at lunch.

kyoto_dough_bakery.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery — sourdough, ciabatta, pizza bianca and rossa, brioche maritozzi, doughnuts, scones (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_dough_bakery.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain hard breads such as sourdough and pizza bianca may be plant-based, but no ingredient list is published; many items use cheese, cream, eggs or butter (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_dough_bakery.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Saturday 11:00–16:00; closed Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday; extra closures announced on social media (Tabelog). Reviewers describe three opening days a week — check Instagram before going (August 2025; June and July 2026). Takeaway only; the shop fits one or two customers at a time (July 2026). Items can be reserved for pickup, and some made to order; on Thursdays and Sundays the team is at the workshop and answers the phone; nationwide shipping on request (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Often sells out early (May 2026). South of the Imperial Palace off Marutamachi on Fuyacho, about 7 min from Marutamachi Stn (2026 reviews; Tabelog). Opened 23 January 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_dough_bakery.notes: [Bakery · Fuyacho below the Imperial Palace, three days a week] A tiny takeaway bakery — room for one or two customers — selling serious hard breads (sourdough, blue-cheese ciabatta, Roman pizza bianca) alongside American sweets: cinnamon doughnuts, a tiramisu maritozzo, crumbles. Open only Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Saturday from 11:00, often sold out early; reserve by phone. No cards.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer writes that the bakery began in 2003 as “BREAD ROOM” and moved and renamed itself Dough at this address in 2015 (Tabelog gives an opening date of January 2015).
chef_bio.specialty: Hard breads; cinnamon doughnuts; tiramisu maritozzo.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 shopper arrived after 16:00 and found the shop still open because customers with reservations had not yet collected.
A December 2025 regular wants every resident of Kyoto to try the cinnamon doughnut.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Dough、パン、中京区舟屋町424、丸太町駅から589m、月・火・金・土 11:00〜16:00、水・木・日定休 (臨時休業はSNSで案内)、取り置き予約可、木・日は工房で仕込み中のため電話対応、全国発送も相談可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR可、テイクアウト、2015年1月23日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1〜2人しか入れない小さな店、サワードウ、ブルーチーズとくるみのチャバタ、ピッツァ・ビアンカ、ティラミスのマリトッツォ、シナモンドーナツ、2003年に「BREAD ROOM」として開業し2015年に移転・改名との声、売り切れが早い。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny takeaway counter; point at the breads. Check opening days on Instagram; reserve by phone.

kyoto_kyosaimi_nomura_karasuma.gf_detail: Ask. Pick-your-own obanzai from a showcase — simmered, grilled and dressed dishes, many in soy and dashi (teriyaki mackerel, ganmo, hijiki) — with rice, miso soup and a yuba rice bowl; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyosaimi_nomura_karasuma.vegan_detail: Ask. Many of the obanzai are vegetables, beans, tofu and yuba, but dashi and fish or meat dishes (mackerel, duck, pork belly) are mixed in, and the broths are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyosaimi_nomura_karasuma.hours_raw: 7:00–14:00 daily; may close early when food runs out; open year-round, New Year by inquiry (Tabelog). No reservations — first come, first served (Tabelog). Order at a touch-panel ticket machine, then choose obanzai at the showcase (October 2026). No cover or charge (Tabelog, original 「なし。」). Cards (VISA), IC and e-money, QR (Tabelog). 36 seats: 10 at the counter, 26 at tables; wheelchair access; free Wi-Fi; children welcome (Tabelog). Rice refills not offered (October 2026). The Miyabi Gozen is limited and can sell out (Tabelog). On Takoyakushi just west of Karasuma, 3 min from Shijo / Karasuma Stns exit 22 (Tabelog). Opened 12 June 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyosaimi_nomura_karasuma.notes: [Obanzai · Shijo Karasuma, breakfast from 7:00] A bright counter-and-table room just off Karasuma where you buy a ticket and pick six (or twelve, or eighteen) small dishes of Kyoto home cooking from a showcase, with rice and miso soup — about ¥850, or ¥1,000 with a yuba rice bowl. A good early Japanese breakfast before sightseeing. No bookings; busy with tourists at times. A second shop is in Nishiki.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer notes that the company supplies its dishes to department stores. A September 2026 diner thought the dishes looked aimed at international guests and suspected the miso soup and sides were pre-made; other 2026 reviewers praise the gentle, home-style flavours.
chef_bio.specialty: Pick-your-own obanzai sets; yuba rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor arrived at 7:10 to find two groups already eating, with more coming in.
An October 2026 diner wished the rice could be refilled, the obanzai being so good with it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京菜味のむら 烏丸本店、日本料理・カフェ・豆腐料理、中京区蛸薬師通烏丸西入橋弁慶町224、四条駅・烏丸駅22番出口から徒歩3分、毎日7:00〜14:00、材料がなくなり次第終了、年中無休、予約不可 (先着順)、チャージなし、カード (VISA)・電子マネー・QR可、36席 (カウンター10、テーブル26)、車椅子可、子ども可、2015年6月12日オープン、「Miyabi Gozen」は数量限定。食べログ京都の店名検索では錦店もある。口コミ (2026年、英語): 券売機で選び、ショーケースからおばんざいを6品、白米か雑穀米と味噌汁で約850円、湯葉丼付き約1,000円、12品の Miyabi Gozen とビールのセット1,800円、朝食向き、百貨店にも卸しているとのこと。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine and point-to-choose showcase; easy without Japanese. Popular with inbound tourists (October 2026).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026; official site under maintenance on 2026-11-06.

kyoto_momoharu_teramachi.gf_detail: Not GF: the menu centres on an egg sandwich on soft bread, French toast and cakes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_momoharu_teramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg sandwich, French toast and cakes; coffee is the only plant-based item reviewers mention (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_momoharu_teramachi.hours_raw: 11:00–17:00; closed Tuesday and Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); expect a short wait at lunch and on weekends (November 2025; September 2026). 9 seats: 4 at tables and 5 at the counter; non-smoking; signs ask guests to speak quietly (Tabelog; September 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 2F of the Taneike building on Teramachi-dori near Marutamachi, overlooking the street; 4 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 1 September 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_momoharu_teramachi.notes: [Café · Teramachi Marutamachi, upstairs and quiet] A nine-seat café on the second floor above Teramachi-dori, known for its egg sandwich: a thick omelette of three or four eggs, made to order and served steaming, with a sweet-tangy sauce, ¥880. French toast, cakes and hand-dripped coffee roasted in-house, from a house blend to single origins. Calm and bookish, with a quiet-please sign; often a short wait. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 1 September 2015, nine seats, registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers describe beans roasted in-house each morning and hand-dripped (July 2026), books to read (December 2025) and a feature in the magazine Kuuneru (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Egg sandwich.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor, having read about the café in the magazine Kuuneru, ordered the egg sandwich and blend to recreate the cover photo at the counter.
A December 2025 pilgrim on the Rakuyo 33 Kannon temple circuit stopped in, hungry, for an egg sandwich and a Mandheling.
The omelette is made from three to four eggs seasoned only with salt, with a demi-glace and ketchup sauce between egg and bread — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、中京区常盤木町55 種池ビル 2F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩4分、11:00〜17:00、火曜・木曜定休、予約不可、9席 (テーブル4、カウンター5)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2015年9月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 寺町通の2階、厚くて熱々の玉子サンド880円 (卵3〜4個、塩だけで焼き、デミグラスとケチャップのソース)、フレンチトースト880円、本日のケーキ、ブランデーケーキ、毎朝自家焙煎のハンドドリップのコーヒー、ブレンド660円、エチオピア、ブラジル、グアテマラ、マンデリン、カフェラテ、本が置いてある、「お静かに」の貼り紙、雑誌「Kuuneru」に掲載。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at your seat; keep voices low; cash only; small, so you may wait.

kyoto_shimiru_misoshiru.gf_detail: Ask. Miso soups from around Japan — one option is Kagoshima barley miso, which contains barley — with rice bowls dressed in a sesame sauce; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_shimiru_misoshiru.vegan_detail: Ask. The soups are full of vegetables and tofu, but one reviewer remarks on the dashi and the rice bowls use bonito flakes, tuna flakes, chicken or egg; some soups are pork-based (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shimiru_misoshiru.hours_raw: Daily 8:30–14:00 (Tabelog); mixed rice can sell out by about 12:30 (May 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter on entry (June 2026). 20 seats: 6 at the counter and 2 tables of 4, with tatami seating; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). In a narrow alley of townhouses between Karasuma and Omiya, a block from Shijo-dori; 5 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_shimiru_misoshiru.notes: [Miso soup · Shijo Karasuma back alley, breakfast and lunch] A miso-soup specialist tucked in a townhouse lane west of Shijo Karasuma: pick a rice (bonito flakes, tuna flakes with egg yolk, chicken and burdock) and one of about nine hearty soups made with miso from around Japan — Hokkaido corn and potato, or Kyoto white miso with a whole tomato — with small sides, for about ¥1,100. Counter and tatami. Some find the soups mild, some salty; one summer visit had a broken air conditioner. Open daily from 8:30.

roles: Owner (unnamed; called young by a July 2026 reviewer) and staff
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a miso-soup specialist offering five kinds of miso — Hokkaido, Aichi Hatcho, Kyoto white, Kagoshima barley and Niigata floating koji — in sets of rice, miso soup and a daily side, in a Japanese-style room with counter and tatami seats; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 describe a hidden shop in an alley of townhouses, found via Instagram (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Miso soups from all over Japan in a relaxing Japanese room (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Regional miso soups with vegetables.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 traveller, a ramen man whose wife picked the place, ordered bonito-flake rice with an Okinawa-style miso soup and called it a great start to the trip.
In July 2026 the air conditioning broke; a single fan cooled a few seats while other guests sweated over the soup.
A September 2026 visitor from Kanto chose the Kyoto white miso soup with a whole tomato and found a surprisingly large sweet potato inside.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂、下京区新釜座町735-2、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩約5分、地下鉄四条駅から徒歩約6分、毎日 8:30〜14:00、予約可、20席 (カウンター6、4人がけテーブル2)、座敷あり、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。店の紹介: 味噌汁専門店、北海道の味噌、愛知の八丁味噌、京都の白味噌、鹿児島の麦味噌、新潟の浮き麹味噌の5種、ご飯と味噌汁と日替わりの小鉢のセット、カウンターと座敷。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 町家の並ぶ細い路地、入口で注文と支払い、ご飯 (おかか、ツナ、鶏ごぼう、釜飯など) と約9種の味噌汁から選ぶ、北海道のとうもろこしとじゃがいも、京野菜と丸ごとトマトの白味噌汁、沖縄風の豚汁のような味噌汁、ごまだれ、卵黄、小鉢 (卵焼き、たくあん、もやし)、セット1,100円、味が薄い・塩辛いとの声、エアコンの故障 (2026年7月)、男性アイドルグループの映像が流れていた (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter; pick a rice and a soup; cards, e-money and QR.

kyoto_agreable_ebisugawa.gf_detail: Not GF: a French patisserie of tarts, roll cakes, mille-feuille, choux, sablés and financiers (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_agreable_ebisugawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: all dairy comes from Takahashi Dairy, with cream, custard, butter and eggs throughout (June 2026).
kyoto_agreable_ebisugawa.hours_raw: Opens 10:00 and closes when sold out — usually by early afternoon (Tabelog; September 2026); closed on irregular days, posted on Instagram (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Come early for choice; queues at opening on busy days (January 2025). No reservations (Tabelog). 4 seats at one table; mostly takeaway; packs cakes with ice for long trips (Tabelog; April 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Under a yellow awning on Ebisugawa-dori east of Takakura; 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 12 April 2013 (Tabelog).
kyoto_agreable_ebisugawa.notes: [Patisserie · Ebisugawa near Marutamachi, takeaway] A small French patisserie under a yellow awning, opened in 2013 by chef Kato, trained at Gérard Mulot in Paris. Classic cakes at fair prices — tarts with Nagano apricots or raspberries, Fraisier, a firm-layered mille-feuille, opera, Black Forest — plus roll cakes, cream puffs and a much-loved lemon sablé, all with Takahashi Dairy cream and butter. Opens at 10 and sells out by early afternoon; irregular closing days. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: A June 2026 reviewer writes that the shop was opened in April 2013 by Chef Kato, who trained at Gérard Mulot, and that all dairy comes from the Hokkaido series of Takahashi Dairy; Tabelog gives the opening date as 12 April 2013. An April 2026 regular thanks "the chef and madam" for such treats at these prices.
chef_bio.specialty: Lemon sablé; Agre roll cake; Fraisier.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor from Tokyo had cakes packed with ice packs in a cooler bag for the trip home, all arriving undamaged.
On 2 January 2025 the shop opened for the new year, and a guest five minutes late found a line already inside — fifth in the queue.
A December 2025 visitor finally got in after struggling to find a day the shop was open.

Self-service; takeaway, with a small eat-in counter and tables; laptops not allowed in the eat-in (Tabelog remarks; 2026 reviews). kyoto_the_bread_yaoichi_honkan.notes: [Bakery · Karasuma Oike, inside Yaoichi Honkan] The in-house bakery on the ground floor of Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan, a big produce store near Karasuma Oike: self-service trays of croissants, hard breads and plenty of vegetable breads — Kujo negi and bacon épi, maitake rolls, burdock and tuna — plus sandwiches, mostly ¥300–400. Small eat-in corner, no laptops. Cards but no QR. Open daily to 21:00.

kyoto_cafe_fufufuan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the café is built around nama-fu, which is wheat gluten, along with yuba, muffins and pizza (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_fufufuan.vegan_detail: Ask. The café says its dishes contain no meat, but some use dairy and some use fish in the broth (Tabelog, restaurant’s own note).
kyoto_cafe_fufufuan.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed Wednesday (open on some Wednesday holidays) and 29 December–4 January (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). Lunch and tea times can mean a short wait (July–August 2026). 63 seats, including window counters and sofas; groups up to 12; non-smoking; children welcome; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transit IC, iD, QUICPay and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the 3rd floor of the 半兵衛麸 Gojo Building above the shop, with a glass wall over the Kamo River, 83 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Moved here from across the street from the 半兵衛麸 main store; opened 28 April 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_fufufuan.notes: [Café · Gojo by the Kamo River, sweets and lunch of fresh fu] The bright upstairs café of 半兵衛麸, Kyoto's old maker of fu (wheat gluten), with a glass wall looking over the Kamo River at Gojo. Come for nama-fu dengaku with sweet miso, Benkei (fu and yuba in a savoury sauce over rice) at lunch, or chewy fu in zenzai and a matcha parfait. Meat-free, though some dishes use dairy or fish broth. Shop for fu downstairs. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Run by 株式会社半兵衛麸 (invoice holder); no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café produced by the fu maker 半兵衛麸, serving dishes and sweets of freshly made nama-fu and nama-yuba; moved from across the street from the 半兵衛麸 main store and opened on 28 April 2022 (pre-opening 15 April). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社半兵衛麸. The company’s restaurant at the main store, 茶房 半兵衛, is a separate record.

kyoto_honke_jubei.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style sushi seasoned with soy-simmered toppings, rice cooked in kombu dashi, and kappo dishes; no gluten information is published; allergies can be raised when booking omakase (official site).
kyoto_honke_jubei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi house; the rice is cooked in kombu dashi, but the menu is built on fish (official site).
kyoto_honke_jubei.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:15–13:30); dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday and irregularly (official site); Tabelog shows dinner to 21:00 daily. Takeout of most sushi at slightly lower prices (official menu). Bookings welcome for both; omakase needs booking, with likes, dislikes, allergies and budget given in advance (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no QR; paid parking nearby (Tabelog). English, Chinese and Korean menus online (official site). In the 占出山 float district on Nishikikoji east of Muromachi, 2 min from exit 22 of Shijo or Karasuma Stn (official site). Founded 1936 in Gion (Nawate-Shinbashi); moved here in March 2011 (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_honke_jubei.notes: [Sushi · Nishiki-Muromachi, Kyoto-style sushi since 1936] A ten-seat counter keeping old Kyoto sushi alive: rice cooked in kombu dashi and seasoned to stand up to the fish, and house classics like the 磯巻 roll, sweet おぼろ巻 and mackerel bo-zushi, all available to take away. Lunch sets start around ¥2,000; evenings bring omakase of nigiri and kappo dishes from ¥9,900. Founded in Gion in 1936 by a master of decorative sushi, now run by the third generation. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1936 in Gion (Nawate, above Shinbashi) by 荒木 信次, a leading craftsman of decorative sushi who spread the technique nationwide and wrote a sushi textbook; the second generation, 照雄, held senior posts in the sushi trade association; the third, 荒木 一雄, built today’s "sushi and kappo" style. The shop moved to the 占出山 float district in March 2011. A May 2025 reviewer recalls seven or eight 重兵衛 in Gion some 30 years ago, including one at the now-closed Fujita Hotel.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: gratitude to guests, to ingredients and to the trade; as a Kyoto-sushi house the rice comes first — aged Kyoto or Omi rice cooked in kombu dashi so it tastes deeper the more you chew.
chef_bio.specialty: 名物 磯巻; 名代 鯖寿し; omakase of sushi and kappo dishes.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 omakase guest was asked at the start about favourite and least favourite ingredients.

A September 2024 visitor found the owner quiet and the fish excellent, and noted a rare Muraza beef on the menu.

kyoto_chugoku_kyozen_suiren.notes: [Chinese · Nijo, sizzling shark-fin ramen] A quiet restaurant near Nijo Station known for one thing: a rich, slightly sweet shark-fin sauce poured sizzling over ramen or rice. The lunch sets (about ¥3,500–4,500) add a clear soup, crisp spring rolls and dim sum; dinners are full courses. A celebrity YouTube visit made it hard to book — plan a month ahead, and expect to wait about six months before a second booking. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a shark-fin specialist near Nijo; a long-time local regular says it has become very hard to book after celebrity coverage on YouTube and in a magazine, and that a restroom notice now asks first-time guests to wait about six months before rebooking (July 2026).

kyoto_ristorante_dono.gf_detail: Ask. Courses include fresh pasta (tagliolini), wood-fired bread, tarts and lasagna; no gluten information is published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ristorante_dono.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led courses that also include fish, venison, wagyu and dairy; nothing vegan is offered on the published menus (official site).
kyoto_ristorante_dono.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–20:00, Tuesday–Saturday; lunch 12:00–14:00, Wednesday–Saturday; closed Sunday and Monday (official site). Fully booked by reservation only; tables are turned after two hours; a confirmation call two days ahead, without which the booking may be cancelled; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; private room for 6 at an extra charge (official site). Course prices include tax and service (税サ込). 24 seats; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of the ボーパサージュ京都岡崎 building, looking out on the great torii of Heian Shrine, 365 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened April 2024 (official site; Tabelog 18 April).
kyoto_ristorante_dono.notes: [Italian · Okazaki, a forager's vegetable Italian by Heian Shrine] Big windows onto the Heian Shrine torii and the scent of a wood fire: chef Toshifumi Nakahigashi, son of the family behind 草喰 なかひがし, picks wild plants and vegetables every morning as the heart of Italian courses — leaf minestra, matsutake tagliolini, venison with wild grape, herbal tea to close. Lunch ¥12,000, dinner from ¥14,500, tax and service included. Michelin Green Star. Reservations only; closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: born and raised in Kyoto in 1982; the father runs 草喰 なかひがし at Ginkakuji and a cousin runs 美山荘 in Hanase. Went to Italy alone at 18 and cooked mains at the two-star Ristorante Arnolfo in Tuscany, then trained at Villa Fiordaliso on Lake Garda (one star) and Alain Ducasse au Plaza Athénée in Paris (three stars). Back in Japan, head chef of Prinz in Ichijoji, then opening chef for The St. Regis Osaka from 2010; opened erba da nakahigashi in Nishi-Azabu, Tokyo, in 2016, renamed it 草片 cusavilla on 22 February 2021 with a stronger vegetable focus, and opened ristorante DONO in Okazaki, Kyoto, in April 2024. Listed with a Michelin Green Star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto–Osaka 2025 (official site). A May 2026 reviewer names the chef Toshifumi Nakahigashi, second son of the Nakahigashi family; the invoice registration is in the chef’s own name.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: "Dono" means sharing in Italian — to share nature’s gifts, gathered from the mountains and fields every morning, with guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable and wild-plant courses; matsutake tagliolini in autumn.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner heard that the ingredients are gathered from the mountains every day and found the owner friendly and full of stories.
An August 2026 lunch party was seen off at the door by the chef.
An October 2026 guest who had often eaten at the father’s restaurant found the same love of vegetables here in Italian form.

kyoto_le_bac_a_sable.hours_raw: Tabelog: 8:00–19:00, closed Wednesday; hours may change. A June 2026 diner found it had been closed for a long stretch earlier. 11 seats — 5 at the counter, 6 at tables — for eating in; you can warm bread yourself (June 2026); take-out; no reservations; non-smoking; children welcome. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened 11 October 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_le_bac_a_sable.notes: [Bakery café · by Higashiyama Station, quiches and croissants] A brick-counter bakery a minute from Higashiyama Station, open from 8 am, with a French owner per reviewers: buttery croissants, a row of ¥400 quiches, fruit tarts and very low prices. Opinions split — some praise the croissants and wheat flavour, others found the quiche bland and the bread dense (June, October 2026). Cash only. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-baker, not named; French per reviewers (June and September 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 11 October 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a European-style room with a brick counter and tiled floor near Higashiyama Station, round "storybook" breads, many quiches, low prices, a French owner baking, and many foreign customers.
chef_bio.specialty: Quiche; croissant.

anecdotes.text: "While the prices are very affordable, my overall impression was that the flavors were lacking" — salt bread with no butter taste, a tasteless quiche, but a delicious pear tart (June 2026).
A September 2026 diner had read that a French owner bakes here, "however, from the items I purchased this time, I couldn’t really detect a French taste."
November 2026: salt bread eaten on a stroll — "The aroma of wheat is incredible."

kyoto_kaze_eda.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: dim sum wrappers, wonton and ramen noodles, spring rolls and kara-age (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaze_eda.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-filled dim sum, chicken-bone and shrimp broths, collagen soup (official site; reviews).
kyoto_kaze_eda.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch Tue–Fri 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00), on about three of those days a week; dinner Tue–Sun and holidays 17:30–22:30 (last orders food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Monday. The official site posts the lunch days each month and takes take-out set orders by the day before, for pickup 17:30–20:30. Cards at dinner only; PayPay and Alipay at both (Tabelog). 20 seats — 6 at the counter, three tables for 4, a tatami room; non-smoking; children welcome (say when booking how many children will not eat an adult portion). Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). Opened 9 September 2006 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kaze_eda.notes: [Chinese dim sum & obanzai · near Shijo-Karasuma, gentle flavours] A twenty-seat Chinese dining room in the old kimono-wholesale streets near Shijo-Karasuma, since 2006: handmade xiao long bao, a lobster-and-shrimp "Ebi-nyan" ramen, kara-age lunch sets and a shelf of aged Shaoxing wines. Lunch only on about three weekdays, packed by noon. No service charge. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 September 2006 (Tabelog). The official site calls it a place for Chinese and yum-cha food and obanzai, gentle on the body, in Kyoto’s kimono district. Reviewers in 2025–2026 praise kind staff, an owner whose care shows in the food, a calm room, help choosing Shaoxing wine, and a willingness to adjust the heat.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「体に優しい中華料理」 — Chinese food that is kind to the body.
chef_bio.specialty: Xiao long bao; Ebi-nyan ramen.

anecdotes.text: After the Gion Matsuri in a yukata, a July 2026 regular came for the chilled collagen ramen — "the wobbly collagen jelly paired perfectly with the ramen."
"At first glance, the portions may seem small, but each item is crafted with care in terms of flavor and aroma." — December 2025.
An October 2026 first-timer "knew nothing about Shaoxing wine, but they took the time to explain it."

kyoto_sushi_noboru.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, fried horse mackerel, a whale cutlet and homemade satsuma-age sit beside sushi seasoned with soy (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_noboru.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi counter; dobin-mushi, chawanmushi and clam miso soup on dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_noboru.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–21:00 without a break; closed Wednesday and Thursday; hours may change. About 10 counter seats; non-smoking; private hire; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Same-day phone bookings taken (October 2026); weekend afternoons nearly full (April 2026). Prices are not on the menu; about ¥10,000–15,000 a head (October 2026; reviews). About 15 chilled sakes (July 2025). Opened 8 March 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_noboru.notes: [Sushi · Higashiyama-Sanjo back alley, all-day counter] A ten-seat sushi counter in an alley by Higashiyama Station, open 11:30–21:00 without a break: a long board of sake snacks — wild buri, simmered kinmedai, homemade satsuma-age, seasonal dobin-mushi — then nigiri piece by piece. One regular has been ten times since mid-2025. No prices on the menu; about ¥10,000–15,000. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Not named in a source; "friendly young chefs" (August 2025)
chef_bio.background: Opened 8 March 2024 (Tabelog). A July 2026 diner says it belongs to the Komatsu sushi group and is backed by a tuna wholesaler (not confirmed elsewhere). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a clean, bright counter of about ten seats in a back alley near Higashiyama-Sanjo, young chefs, many regulars, warm service to newcomers, and a menu that changes with each season’s catch.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sake snacks and nigiri; wild buri; homemade satsuma-age.

anecdotes.text: A regular logged ten visits from July 2025 to November 2026, from the first sanma and matsutake to fugu and seiko crab "soon" — "I feel like winter has arrived all at once."
April 2026: the chef explained that the fish is aged overnight, because it can be too firm when freshly prepared.
"The prices were not listed on the menu at all. It was JPY 10,000 per person." — October 2026.
"The attention to detail in the preparation is evident, although the prices might be a bit on the higher side." — October 2025.

kyoto_karucha_cafe.notes: [Cheesecake café · between Karasuma Oike and Marutamachi, the cheese-and-mouse cakes] A cheese-sweets café in a renovated machiya: cheesecakes shaped like storybook cheese with a chocolate mouse peeking out, ¥560–680, plus carbonara and omurice at lunch and Uji teas. Order by QR upstairs, overlooking a small garden. One diner missed syrup for the drinks. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 20 February 2023 (Tabelog). The official site describes a cheese-sweets speciality shop with cheesecakes "as if jumped out of a picture book", fluffy yet light, in a café with Showa-era nostalgia and the feel of an old Kyoto house. It sells online and at department-store events (a September 2026 diner found it at Shinjuku Takashimaya). Reviewers in 2026 note cheese-themed decor, shovel-shaped spoons, a garden view upstairs, and polite staff.
chef_bio.specialty: 口福のチーズケーキ (the mouse cheesecake).

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "as soon as I poured the cream cheese sauce over it, the face melted away."
"There were no syrups or sugars available, and as someone with a sweet tooth, I wished I could add some syrup to my drink..." — June 2026.
A local worker waited until the opening queues died down: "I thought it was just a cake shop, but they also serve as a cafe!" (July 2026).

kyoto_gion_okuoka.gf_detail: Ask. Udon and somen are wheat; yudofu, simmered sea bream, sukiyaki and hot pots come with soy-based broths and sauces (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_okuoka.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and there is yudofu, but broths are likely dashi-based (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_okuoka.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; dinner courses about ¥10,000, and portions were lightened on request (July 2026 review). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし" (its English says a service fee is added). 34 seats at sunken-kotatsu and tatami tables; the 2nd floor takes parties of up to 25; one reviewer describes a basement room with a counter (October 2025). Designated smoking area. Children welcome. Cards, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). In a machiya on the main road in front of the Higashiyama Yasui bus stop, between Gion and Kiyomizu-dera (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_okuoka.notes: [Kyoto set meals & yudofu · Higashiyama Yasui] A calm machiya on the road between Gion and Kiyomizu-dera, with sunken-kotatsu seats: yudofu or simmered sea bream sets with obanzai, white-miso sukiyaki, and in summer a cold sudachi udon floating with citrus slices. Lunch about ¥1,500–3,500; dinner courses about ¥10,000. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: Kyoto cuisine in a traditional townhouse with a garden view; Kyoto and regional sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Yudofu set meals; sudachi udon.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 lunch guest asking the way was kindly helped by staff.
An October 2025 group found service slow that day, which left time to talk over the trip.
Two women on a ¥10,000 course in July 2026 asked for lighter portions; the unfinished pot rice was packed to take away.
An April 2026 repeat diner found the simmered sea bream a little salty.

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off for tatami and kotatsu seats; set meals easy to order.

kyoto_kanya_gussan_toko.gf_detail: Ask. Chijimi and noodles are wheat; gukbap is rice in pork-bone broth seasoned at the table with gochujang and miso, which can contain wheat (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kanya_gussan_toko.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone soup, bossam, chicken and seafood dishes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kanya_gussan_toko.hours_raw: Mon–Wed 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); Fri–Sun 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Thursday, with occasional irregular days (Tabelog). Lunch is gukbap only and ends when it sells out (April 2026 review). Book for dinner — walk-ins were turned away on a full night (December 2025 review). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats, shared tables at lunch; non-smoking (Tabelog; April 2026 review). One cook in the kitchen, so dishes take time — one July 2026 diner waited about an hour (2025–26 reviews). North of Gojo; 350 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kanya_gussan_toko.notes: [Korean home cooking · north of Gojo] A small, warm family-run Korean kitchen: at lunch only daeji gukbap, a pork-bone soup you season yourself; at night bossam, crisp chijimi from the iron pan, japchae and makgeolli. About ¥1,500 at lunch, ¥4,000–5,000 at night. One cook, so expect a wait; book dinner; cash only. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the owner explaining how to season the gukbap (September 2025), a single cook in the kitchen (December 2025), and "the kind mother, sister, and the chef" at work (July 2026). Featured on TV in 2025 (September 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Dwaeji gukbap; bossam; chijimi.

anecdotes.text: When the lunch dish came, the owner apologised for the wait — September 2025.
A diner who lives near Shin-Okubo apologised for doubting Korean food in Kyoto; five ate for just over ¥20,000 — December 2025.
Warned in advance that the one-person kitchen was slow, a December 2025 table waited comfortably and got crispy rice candy at the end.
An October 2025 regular on a third visit said the trip to Kyoto was for this restaurant alone.

kyoto_salao.gf_detail: Ask. The chicken rice is pilaf stuffed in a whole chicken, but sauces (demi-glace, cream, curry) and fried shrimp likely contain wheat (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_salao.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, hamburg steak, fish and liver pâté (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_salao.hours_raw: 11:30–16:00 (last order 15:00) and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Monday (holidays too) and the 1st and 3rd Sunday (Tabelog). Tabelog also says last orders are 10 minutes before closing — 14:50 and 19:50. Online bookings for dinner only, none after 19:30; at lunch, write your name on the waiting list — about 40 minutes in July 2026 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog; June 2026 review). Prices include tax, no service charge (October 2026 review). 24 seats, tables only, on two floors; ring the bell at the top of the stairs to order (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Children welcome with notice; no car or bicycle parking (Tabelog). On Nijo-dori; 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_salao.notes: [Yoshoku bistro · Nijo-dori near City Hall] A small two-floor bistro with a cat on its sign, famous for its "adult chicken rice": a whole crisp chicken stuffed with pilaf, with your pick of six sauces (¥1,650 at lunch, with salad). Lunch queues are common — leave your name and wander. Cash only; closed Monday and the 1st and 3rd Sunday.

roles: Operator unnamed; a pastry chef makes the celebration cakes (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog's shop text says it relocated in 2023; its listed opening day is 25 March 2024. Reviewers knew it near the City Hall before the move (August and October 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Adult chicken rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner found the tables close together and conversation hard with loud customers nearby.
Ordering the bitter demi-glace in October 2026, a guest was warned it is "a unique sauce that divides opinions"; the chicken took thirty minutes.

A July 2026 walk-in wrote a name on the list, strolled the neighbourhood and waited about forty minutes.

kyoto_nitta_bakery.notes: [Bakery · behind Rokuharamitsu-ji] A tiny weekend-only bakery in the lanes between Kiyomizu and Gojo: flaky croissants, salt-butter rolls, chocolate Danish bars, passion-fruit cream buns, croque monsieur and baguettes, mostly ¥200–600. Fri–Sun from 8:00; expect a short queue; take away.

chef_bio.background: Opened 13 September 2018 after a three-day pre-opening (Tabelog). Featured on the TV show "Seven Rules" (August 2026 review).
